techniques.name: Berserker
techniques.flavor: I don't respect people who wait for an opponent to act. Every breath they take is energy that could be spent fighting, living! They stall my potential, take the joy out of my violence! So I ask: Can we be friends?

levels.name: Revenge
levels.text: After you take a Wound, you may spend up to 2 AP as if it was your Turn, all Actions you take when doing this count as Reactions.

levels.name: Cornered Dog
levels.text: If you receive an Effect, you may take 2 damage instead.

levels.name: Take A Beating
levels.text: The first time you take damage each Turn, gain 1 Focus. If that damage would deal a Wound to you, Charge at no Cost as a Reaction.

techniques.name: Dragonslayer
techniques.flavor: I felt stupid for for staring. With the size of our quarry I should have expected my hunt-mates bringing comparable arms, but that… club? It was ridiculous, even more so with how he carried it. I wanted to make a comment, but with how the others greeted him it seems like I'm the only one who would think it's strange.

levels.name: Speed Is Weight
levels.text: If your Body Finisher is the first attack on your Turn, you gain 2 Focus and Shred your target before dealing damage.

levels.name: Wide Arc
levels.text: When spending 3 or more Focus on a Body Finisher, you can have it target enemies in a 2x2 Zone placed on yourself.

levels.name: Titanic Heave [ Breathe → Body Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher counts all dice rolled as Hits, pushes enemies it hits 2 spaces back, and Weakens you after it resolves.

techniques.name: Duelist
techniques.flavor: What's wrong, out of breath? I recall you were talking real big with all that "I'll only need one strike" garbage. So go on. Hit me.

levels.name: Riposte [ Block → Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish lets you move 3 spaces before targeting and Taunts your target.

levels.name: Parry
levels.text: Your Blocks give [Tension] additional Armor. Using Block against an adjacent character Dazes your Attacker and pushes them instead of you.

levels.name: Deflecting Blow
levels.text: After you Block an Attack and reduce its damage to 1 or less, you may spend 1 Focus to Strengthen yourself and Skirmish.

techniques.name: Flagellant
techniques.flavor: I was in the later waves the Watchers sent, and at that point the fog was coming in heavy. I didn't see much, but what I saw I won't soon forget. The violet light of their eyes pierced through the fog, and the pain fey trailing off their wounds like a commander's ribbons.

levels.name: Thrill
levels.text: After you receive a Negative Effect, you may also Strengthen yourself.

levels.name: Wild Rush
levels.text: The first time you Skirmish each Turn, before targeting, you may Blight yourself to move up to 2 spaces in a Line. If you're already Blighted, Mark yourself instead and move up to 3 spaces. If the target's Adjacent, you gain 1 Advantage for each space moved.

levels.name: Bled Dry
levels.text: The first attack you make each Turn deals additional damage equal to the number of different effects you have, and after it resolves you may clear a number of negative effects equal to the crits you rolled.

techniques.name: Gunslinger
techniques.flavor: Adept knights know their guns as well as they know themselves; each part maintained and accounted for. Famous knights just need to let shots fly.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Big Iron
levels.text: You now use ‘Bullets' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 6 Bullets. After you spend Bullets, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within 4 range once per bullet spent. Before you Skirmish, you may spend any number of Bullets, if you spent any, the Skirmish targets all the characters the Bullets damaged instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Lock And Load
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If you end your Turn without spending a Bullet, you can set your Bullets to 6.

levels.name: Bullet Juggle
levels.text: Your attacks that roll 2 or more Crits Launch a target of your choice. Your bonus damage from "Big Iron" is doubled against Launched characters.

techniques.name: Struggler
techniques.flavor: You must be new here bub. We don't really do draws, and we sure as hell aren't gonna let you give up either. This Battalion's for the discarded, and if you can't pick yourself off your sorry ass, no one else will.

levels.name: Effort
levels.text: If you roll a 1 in any Challenge roll, you may reduce your Speed by 1 for the duration of the Scene (to a minimum of 1) to treat it as a 6 instead, converting it to a Critical Hit. If you cannot lower your Speed, you receive [Tier] damage instead.

levels.name: Adrenaline
levels.text: After you take damage on your Turn, you may move up to 3 spaces towards an enemy of your choice. If this brings you adjacent to the enemy, you may Mark them.

levels.name: Defy Reason
levels.text: You may use the effect of "Effort" on any roll that comes from a Finisher, regardless of value.

techniques.name: SpellSword
techniques.flavor: Versatility is a power you can't buy. It must be learned through a complete mastery of all its parts.

levels.name: Twin Suns [ Cast → Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish is Swift, costs Focus instead of AP, and you can Teleport to a space in 4 range before targeting with it.

levels.name: Infused Edge
levels.text: If you end a Combo in a non-Cast Attack, it becomes ‘Infused'. Infused attacks count as a Cast and let you Teleport to a space adjacent to your target after dealing damage, dealing additional damage equal to the Crits you rolled if you do.

levels.name: Witch Hunter [ Cast → Body/Talent Finisher ]
levels.text: If the Finisher targets the same character as the Cast, it deals [Spirit] additional damage.

techniques.name: Technician
techniques.flavor: Oh yeah, just try taking me on with that slapdash, amateurish style! That could never beat a REAL fighter with REAL experience.

levels.name: Stretch
levels.text: After you Charge, you ‘Stretch'. After Stretching, until the end of your next Turn, completing a Combo gives you 1 AP.

levels.name: Perfect Form
levels.text: After you complete a Combo, you gain [Tier/2] Armor until the start of your next Turn.

levels.name: Final Blow [ Skirmish → Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher costs 1 AP and pushes its target 3 spaces away.

techniques.name: Unbroken
techniques.flavor: You must not give in. You cannot! Claw and bite like a cornered rat. It's the only option you have left.

levels.name: Get Back Up
levels.text: Once per Chapter, you may spend an Influence to Resist a Knock Out without becoming Vulnerable. Doing this makes you lose the ability to gain Influence for the remainder of the Scene.

levels.name: Furious Revival
levels.text: After you spend an Influence in a combat Scene, you may take an Action with a cost of 1 for no cost with Swift.

levels.name: Phoenix
levels.text: After you Resist using "Get Back Up" you may set your Wounds to 1.

techniques.name: Braggart
techniques.flavor: You weren't even worth wiping off the stains…

levels.name: Hubris
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Pride', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. While your Pride Clock is full, you gain 1 Advantage on all Rolls for the remainder of the Scene. After you do one of the following, fill one Segment of this Clock: ‣ Get hit by an enemy's Attack without using a Defensive Reaction. ‣ Attack rolling one of your two lowest Attributes.

levels.name: Prove Yourself
levels.text: If your Pride Clock fills, you may ‘Hold Back', emptying the Clock and reducing its total Segments by 2 (to a min of 2). If your Pride Clock has less than 6 Segments, "Hubris" grants one additional Advantage for every two Segments it is less than 6.

levels.name: A Worthy Opponent
levels.text: When an enemy attacks you, you may fill a Pride Segment.

techniques.name: Breacher
techniques.flavor: A hundred pellets at 1600 feet per second hurts about as much as you would expect.

levels.name: Buck Shot
levels.text: Your Skirmishes can Choose a target in 4 range instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes Against targets in 2 range push the target 1 space away.

levels.name: Both Barrels
levels.text: Before you Skirmish, so long as you're not Weakened, you can use ‘Both Barrels'. Doing this gives the Attack [Body/2] Advantage, doubles any push it deals, and Weakens you after it resolves.

levels.name: Annihilate
levels.text: Your Body Finisher can now target characters up to 3 spaces away and can use the effect of "Both Barrels". If you use "Both Barrels" with a Skirmish or Body Finisher, have it affect all targets in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

techniques.name: Dual Wielder
techniques.flavor: My lord used to beat me for my left-handedness. When I killed him, I used both hands. Out of respect.

levels.name: Twinned blow
levels.text: If you Skirmish targeting a single character, you may give it [Tier] disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry', Dealing [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to the same target afterwards. Flurrying counts as a Swift Skirmish at 0 cost. Other techniques cannot change Flurry's targeting.

levels.name: Frenzied Barrage
levels.text: If you spend 2 or more Focus on a finisher, you may give it [Tier] Disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry' twice, each of them targeting a target of the Finisher.

levels.name: Varied Blades
levels.text: Your Skirmishes have an additional two effects that alternate every time you Skirmish, resetting at the start of your Turn (first Skirmish uses effect A, second uses effect B, third uses effect A again). Choose two of the options below as effects: ‣ Astral: Gain [Tier / 2] Focus. ‣ Blazing: Deal [Tier / 2] damage to your target. ‣ Umbral: Teleport to a space within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Vorpal: Restore [Tier / 2] Health. ‣ Phasing: This attack ignores its target's Armor. ‣ Whirling: Move your target [Tier] spaces.

techniques.name: Intimidator
techniques.flavor: You choose: Live on your knees or die on your feet.

levels.name: "Pathetic"
levels.text: After you increase Tension on your Turn or KO Fodder, you may "Impose"; both Fearing enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself, and dealing [Tier] damage to them if they weren't already Feared.

levels.name: "Out Of My Way"
levels.text: Before you move with Stride or Jump, you may change the distance you're moving to [Body]. If you do, you may choose any characters you would move into the space of, and move them 1 space each and Impose after you end your movement.

levels.name: "Fools And Dead Men"
levels.text: After you Knock Out an enemy, gain 2 Focus and 1 AP. After you Knock Out a non-fodder NPC due to the damage dealt through Impose, place a Fodder Zone in their space.

techniques.name: Martial Artist
techniques.flavor: I'm pretty experienced myself y'know. 15 years of Baji Quan, 11 years of Aikido, and a semester of Capoeira. Oh, sorry. We should be dueling about now! I've got a bad habit of bragging when I don't think I'll be seeing someone again.

levels.name: Art Of The 8 Hammers
levels.text: You can't use any part of this Technique if you use Techniques with the "weapon" tag. After you Skirmish or Body / Talent Finisher, you can use one of the following ‘follow ups' on one of your targets. Each can be used once per Round. ‣ Quick Step: Move up to 3 spaces. Gain [Tier] Evasion. ‣ Binding Blow: Snare your target. ‣ Rising Knee: Launch your target. ‣ Iron Shoulder: Push your target 3 spaces.

levels.name: Flow-State
levels.text: Your first Skirmish each Turn is Swift. After you trigger an effect of "Art Of The 8 Hammers", you may deal [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to a character you've attacked this Turn.

levels.name: Unlimited Blows
levels.text: Your attacks gain 1 Advantage. If you roll at least one Crit on a Skirmish or Finisher, "Art Of The 8 Hammers" triggers an additional time.

techniques.name: Monastic Warrior
techniques.flavor: Born under the twin stars, Qayid Āl-Rashid existed in a state of extremes; his life oscillating between terrible misfortune and unforgettable opulence. It was only after he came of age that he learned to balance these chaotic forces, and channel them in battle.

levels.name: Mind Made Manifest
levels.text: While you're Strengthened, gain 2 Armor. While you're Hastened, gain 2 Evasion at the end of your Turn.

levels.name: Calm Within Chaos
levels.text: Begin tracking "Balance", an 8 segment Clock that's emptied after every scene. Fill 1 segment each time you perform a Utility Action after an Attack Action, or an Attack Action after a Utility Action on the same Turn. At the start of your Turn, you may empty 1 segment to Strengthen or Hasten yourself.

levels.name: Sublime Equanimity
levels.text: After you Charge or Awaken this, you may ‘Meditate'. If you Meditate, instead of rolling, gain Evasion equal to the filled Balance segments, then empty your Balance. If your Balance was full, gain [Tier + 1] focus, teleport to any empty space, and perform a swift spirit or mind finisher on an adjacent enemy at no cost. After Meditating you cannot fill balance segments on the same Turn.

techniques.name: Lancer
techniques.flavor: Mankind is a friend to the spear. We grew in wisdom and technique alongside our oldest defender. Know this, vile foe: this thrust carries the weight of all human history behind it!

levels.name: Pierce
levels.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finisher can target one enemy within 2 range instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes gain Advantage equal to your target's distance from you (up to a maximum of 3).

levels.name: Phalanx
levels.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finishers can target an enemy within 3 range instead of its normal targeting. Skirmish affects all opposing targets between yourself and your original target(s), dealing half damage to each.

levels.name: Cannon-Arm [ Breathe → Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish can choose targets up to 4 spaces away and raises the maximum Advantage from "Pierce" to 4. If the attack had 4 or more total Advantage, it additionally affects all targets adjacent to the original, dealing half its damage to said targets. Each affected space becomes Difficult Terrain.

techniques.name: Predator
techniques.flavor: I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I'm hungry. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you.

levels.name: Yearn
levels.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn, it becomes Swift, has its Cost Reduced to 0, and has a range of [Body]. However, it can only be used to ask what your target's current and maximum Health is. When any opponent is Knocked Out while adjacent to you, you heal [Body] Health.

levels.name: Obsess
levels.text: If you know an opponent has half their maximum Health remaining or less, your Speed is increased by 3, and you ignore Difficult Terrain, but you cannot move unless you're moving closer to at least one of said opponents.

levels.name: Envelop
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you heal using "Yearn" you may ‘Siphon', Immobilizing and Dazing yourself. While you're under these Effects, the Focus gained through Breathe and Charge are replaced with health, with it healing a wound and setting your health to 1 if the Health would go past your maximum.

techniques.name: Improvisational Fighter
techniques.flavor: I'll take all you bastards on! I'll flatten your whole damned Pavilion. You'll rue the day you slighted me, and the record will be written in your scars. Well… if I still had my sword. Until then, a concussion and some splinters will do.

levels.name: "This'll Do"
levels.text: You can Interact to ‘Notice Something', creating an Obstacle in 5 range, or to remove an adjacent Obstacle to make a Swift Skirmish or Cast using any Attribute for its Roll.

levels.name: "That One Hurts!"
levels.text: You may Interact at no cost and with Swift once per Round, so long as it doesn't result in an Attack. Attacks from Interact have 3 Advantage.

levels.name: Last Resort
levels.text: Once per scene, you may Attack using "This'll Do", even if there isn't an Obstacle to remove. This use gives the Attack from it [Tension] Advantage.

techniques.name: Warring Ascendant
techniques.flavor: My dearest brother, born on the battlefield. I know you expect more, but I implore you: Lend me your strength, and feel the air on your skin. I call upon you in my time of greatest need, heed, o' Durandal!
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Heavenly Arm
levels.text: Choose a Technique with the "Weapon" Tag. Once per Scene, After you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away and trigger any of its Deploy effects. While Transformed you count as having all three Levels of the Technique you chose, if it has an alternate Foci, track it separately and use it as your Focus while Transformed. If you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Esoteric Blades
levels.text: Choose one other Technique of any kind. While you are transformed, you count as having the first two Levels of that Technique.

levels.name: Saintly Sword, Heaven Piercer
levels.text: You may lose your Transformation before you use a finisher. If you do so, that Finisher affects all targets along an infinitely long Line placed adjacent to you, dealing one additional damage for every targeted character. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

techniques.name: Heroic Ascendant
techniques.flavor: I will not let you destroy my world!
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Warrior Of Legend
levels.text: Once per Scene, After you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away. While Transformed you are Strengthened and Reinforced at all times. If you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Hero's Feat
levels.text: Your Transformation has an additional effect for its duration chosen from the list below. ‣ Feat Of Strength: All your push effects can have their distance doubled, and characters you push adjacent to another character both take [Tier] damage. ‣ Feat Of Speed: Before you take an Action, move up to double its Cost in spaces. If this makes you leave adjacency with enemies, deal [Tier] damage to them. ‣ Feat Of Sturdiness: Reinforced grants you 1 additional Armor. After you reduce incoming damage to 1 or less, deal [Tier] damage to the attacker.

levels.name: Mastered Strength
levels.text: .You may Daze yourself and spend 1 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

techniques.name: Aerial Master
techniques.flavor: I've been looking my entire life. The way she carried me, we must have been miles off the ground. Doesn't matter who she was, or where she was taking me. Don't think I'll be able to sleep until I can ask her…

levels.name: Soar
levels.text: After you Jump, you may Hasten yourself rather than moving. After you're Hastened, you enter ‘Flight Stance', removing other Stances you had. While in Flight, incoming Attacks have [Tier] Disadvantage, and you ignore Terrain and enemies while moving. Attacking removes Flight Stance.

levels.name: Hunt
levels.text: After you Attack a Launched character in Flight (and don't Spike), you may end your Turn to Disappear with them. When either of you reappear, the other appears in an adjacent space of their choice, and you deal [Speed/2] damage to all adjacent enemies.

levels.name: Falling Ax Strike
levels.text: The Attacks you use while in the Flight Stance can roll [Speed] rather than an Attribute. Doing so removes Hastened and Launches your target.

techniques.name: Assassin
techniques.flavor: A bloodied coin spends just as well as any other.

levels.name: Ambush
levels.text: If the first Action you take after Deploying is Hide, it has no Cost and ignores its requirements.

levels.name: Assassinate
levels.text: Attacks you make while Disappeared gain [Tier] Advantage, let you reappear adjacent to characters, and the dice rolled Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Speed of Dark [ Hide → Stride ]
levels.text: The Stride has no cost, turns you Invisible when used, and gives your next Finisher on that Turn [Speed / 2] Advantage.

techniques.name: Sniper
techniques.flavor: A shot that must factor in the curvature of the planet is one worth taking

levels.name: Long Shot
levels.text: Your Talent Finisher can target characters within 5 range instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Bunker Down
levels.text: At the start of the Scene, or If you end your Turn without Attacking, you may ‘Bunker Down', gaining Immobilized. While you're Immobilized, your Talent Finishers gain 5 additional range and Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Deadeye [ Hide → Talent Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher deals [Crits rolled] + [Distance from target] additional damage, and affects opposing targets between yourself and your original target (as per any shortest path).

techniques.name: Skirmisher
techniques.flavor: Float like a butterfly…

levels.name: Sting
levels.text: Once per Turn, if you've moved with Stride on the same Turn, you may ‘Jab' an adjacent target at no Cost. A Jab deals [Talent/2] damage to its target and counts as a Swift Skirmish; features other than this Technique cannot change a Jab's damage or targeting.

levels.name: Shifting Blows
levels.text: You may move up to two spaces in a straight line after Skirmishing.

levels.name: Rebound
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If movement provided by Skirmish moves you into adjacency with a character who hasn't been attacked this Turn, you may Jab them.

techniques.name: Speed Demon
techniques.flavor: It was over before it even started. I don't know who you pissed off, but they moved like nothing I've ever seen.

levels.name: Fade
levels.text: You can move through enemies. You must end your movement in an empty space.

levels.name: Flash Strike
levels.text: After you move out of a character's space using "Fade", you may deal [Talent / 2] damage to them (this is not an Attack). You can't use this on the same target more than once each Round.

levels.name: Flash Step [ Breathe → Stride ]
levels.text: The Stride lets you move triple its normal distance. If you trigger "Flash Strike" while using this, you may Launch any characters you damage.

techniques.name: Untouchable
techniques.flavor: And what's this?! It looks like she can't be hit! They're moving at speeds I can't even keep up with! The champ looks like she's boxing ghosts!

levels.name: Duck
levels.text: The first time you Dodge each Round, gain [Talent] additional Evasion.

levels.name: Weave
levels.text: You can move one additional space when using Dodge. Any time your Evasion reduces damage to 0, you may move as if you Dodged.

levels.name: Fighter's Instinct [ Dodge → Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish lets you move 3 spaces before targeting and lets you Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

techniques.name: Acrobat
techniques.flavor: Obstacles are found everywhere. In overcoming them, we nourish ourselves.

levels.name: Flying Kick [ Jump → Skirmish ]
levels.text: If the Skirmish is against one adjacent target, it gains Advantage equal to the number of spaces you moved during your Jump, up to a max of [Talent].

levels.name: Wall Jump
levels.text: After you end a Jump's movement adjacent to an Obstacle or board edge, you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line and gain 1 Evasion. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement. You can only "Wall Jump" once per Turn.

levels.name: Weightless Body
levels.text: You may "Wall Jump" any number of times in a Jump. You can't use the effect of "Wall Jump" on the same Obstacle or board edge more than once per Jump.

techniques.name: Blade Master
techniques.flavor: A weapon's strength is secondary to the strength of those who wield it.

levels.name: Draw Stance
levels.text: After you Breathe or Charge, you may enter ‘Draw Stance', removing any other Stances you had. This effect ends after you Attack, Stride, or Jump. If you use a Talent Finisher or Skirmish in Draw Stance, you can Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Divide In One Motion [ Breathe → Jump ]
levels.text: The Jump does not end Draw Stance. After using the Jump, you may use a Talent Finisher at no AP Cost. The Finisher affects all opposing targets you moved into adjacency with or through during your Jump.

levels.name: Leaping Koi
levels.text: If you use "Divide In One Motion", roll the Finisher before using your Jump's Movement. For every Critical Hit rolled in the Finisher, you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement.

techniques.name: Cunning Fighter
techniques.flavor: Heavy Build. Tall. Reach advantage. Confident, capable. Trained in the four forms of Cavalcabo. Their salute will transfer into a sudden flèche. This has served them well against inexperienced opponents. Bind the attack, then transfer to a quick glide. During their shock, apply knee to groin. Begin gloating.

levels.name: Plan and Execute
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Cunning Plan', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. If you Investigate a character who you haven't Investigated this Turn, fill one Cunning Plan Segment. Once per Turn, you may empty a Segment to take any non-Attack Action, reducing its Cost by 1 and gaining Swift.

levels.name: Plans Within Plans
levels.text: "Plan and Execute"s spending portion is no longer once per Turn.

levels.name: At a Glance
levels.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn, you may spend 1 Focus to Swifty Investigate another enemy within [Mind] spaces of the target at no Cost.

techniques.name: Egomaniac
techniques.flavor: Only the most conceited, self-important, piece of sho'vah grit could do what you do. No,that's not a damn compliment!

levels.name: Peak Condition
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Style', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. Whenever you Attack, fill one Style Segment for each of the following conditions that it fulfilled. After you take damage from an Attack, empty one. After you fill the Clock, empty it, move up to 2 spaces in a Line, and gain 1 AP. ‣ Drama: Attack rolled 2 or more Critical Hits. ‣ Dance: Previous action moved you Adjacent to target. ‣ Diversify: You didn't use the Attack on your last Turn. ‣ Denouement: Attack brought you to 0 AP.

levels.name: Dance With Me
levels.text: The first time you move each Turn without spending AP, fill one Style Segment.

levels.name: Finale
levels.text: Your attacks that fill at least 2 Style Segments before dice are rolled Crit on a roll of 5 or 6. Once per Scene, when a single Attack fills 4 Style Segments, you may lose the movement and AP gained from "Peak Condition" to deal [Tension + Tier] Damage to the target of the attack instead.

techniques.name: Enchained
techniques.flavor: These scars and bindings are a reminder of what I was. And in keeping them, I remind myself of what I can be.

levels.name: Hook Shot
levels.text: After you Cast targeting a non-adjacent unoccupied space, you may ‘Swing'. When you do, track your distance from the target, and Teleport to any space an equal distance away from the target.

levels.name: Draw In
levels.text: Before you Cast targeting an opponent, you may choose to have the Cast not deal damage. If you do, the Cast has its Cost reduced to 0, move one space towards them, and pull them one space towards you, repeating until you both can't move any more.

levels.name: Momentum [ Cast → Skirmish ]
levels.text: If movement provided by your Cast moved you adjacent to the target of your Skirmish, you gain [Tier x 2] Advantage on that Skirmish and you push them 4 spaces.

techniques.name: Knife Juggler
techniques.flavor: Though it's fallen slightly out of favor, thrown weapons have been a part of our culture for hundreds of years, and it's time people start respecting that.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Throw
levels.text: You now use ‘Weapons' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 4 Weapons. Before you Skirmish, you can ‘Throw', spending 1 Weapon, reducing the Skirmish's cost to 0, and letting the Skirmish target one character within 4 range instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Resupply
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. After you resolve a Skirmish with Throw, place a ‘Weapon Marker' in the space of your target or an unoccupied space adjacent to it. After you move into a Weapon Marker's space, you may remove it to move 1 space and gain 1 Weapon.

levels.name: Chaser
levels.text: When an enemy leaves the space of a Weapon Marker, you may Teleport to the marker and Punish them at no Focus cost. The Skirmish from this Punish can't use Throw.

techniques.name: Malicious Mimic
techniques.flavor: Impossible… she only saw that technique once!

levels.name: "Anything You Can Do…"
levels.text: Once per Round, after you Dodge or Clash, you gain an ‘Impression' with the same name as the attacker. As an Action with no Cost, you may spend any of your Impressions to use the indicated NPC's Attack as if you were an NPC. All Impressions are lost at the end of a Scene.

levels.name: Rehearsed Movements
levels.text: After you Dodge an NPC while you hold an Impression matching their name, you gain 2 additional Evasion.

levels.name: "…I Can Do Better"
levels.text: After you gain an Impression, you may spend 1 Focus to gain that NPCs Passive effect until you spend the Impression.

techniques.name: Weaponsmith
techniques.flavor: I get nostalgic for the shop, y'know..The smell of oil, the sound of motors and dad's music box. I was always asking where he got that junk, or why our customers wore uniforms. But I never got a straight answer…

levels.name: Trick Weapon
levels.text: Choose an acquired Weapon Technique to become your ‘Primary Form'. Choose a Weapon Technique you don't have to make its first 2 Levels into your ‘Secondary Form'. If it has an alternate Foci, track it separately and use it as your Focus in that Form. Start combat in your Primary Form. Before your first Breathe or Charge each Turn, swap Forms, losing any Techniques from your current Form, and gaining the ones attached to the other, triggering any of their new start of Turn / Scene effects. You cannot unlock your Secondary Form's Levels through Tier increases.

levels.name: Adaptive Edge
levels.text: Upgrade your secondary form to level 3. You may Charge at 1 Cost so long as you haven't swapped forms this Turn.

levels.name: Metalurgy
levels.text: Gain a benefit after you swap for the first time each Turn, based on the Archetype of that Form. ‣ Powerhouse: Strengthen and Reinforce yourself. ‣ Vagabond: Strengthen and Hasten yourself. ‣ Bulwark: Reinforce yourself and gain [Body] Evasion. ‣ Altruist: Strengthen allies within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Disruptor: Snare an enemy within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Ruiner: Gain [Spirit] Focus and Steady yourself.

techniques.name: Modified Meister
techniques.flavor: The vibration of whirring chains, the sound of spinning gears, the buckling of mismatched plating and loose screws. It almost feels like it's alive.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Running Hot
levels.text: You now use ‘Heat' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 0 Heat. Substitute all Focus costs with gaining Heat instead. Effects that would give Focus reduce Heat instead. If your Heat increases to 6 or more, it is reset to 3 and you deal [Mind] damage to yourself and all adjacent enemies.

levels.name: Overload
levels.text: Before you Skirmish or Finisher, you may "Overload", giving it [Mind / 2] Advantage and Blighting the target(s). You receive 1 Heat for every Crit rolled.

levels.name: Overclock
levels.text: After you Breathe with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Overclock' until the end of your next Turn. While Overclocked, dealing or taking any amount of damage generates 1 Heat. Whenever you would explode while Overclocked, you may instead set your Heat to 3 to take [Mind / 2] damage, move up to 3 spaces, and gain 1 AP.

techniques.name: Opportunist
techniques.flavor: You were really expecting a fair fight?

levels.name: Pack Tactics
levels.text: Once per Round, when an ally resolves an Attack on a character within [Talent] spaces, you may Swiftly Skirmish at no Cost, targeting them. If you are outside Skirmish's range, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the target before drawing range.

levels.name: Hungry Eyes
levels.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces targets a character with an attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Mark the target.

levels.name: Launcher Combo
levels.text: Once per Round, when an ally inflicts an Effect to an enemy within [Talent] spaces, you may use the effect "Pack Tactics" on the same target. This level has a separate once per Round limitation from the one in "Pack Tactics".

techniques.name: Reflector
techniques.flavor: Strike me if you dare.

levels.name: Catch The Blade
levels.text: At the beginning of your Turn, you may name any number and note it down until the end of the Scene. If an enemy's attack would deal damage to you equal to a number noted (this includes 0), gain [Mind] Evasion before the damage is dealt.

levels.name: Watch And Wait
levels.text: Whenever you take damage from an enemy, you may note another number with "Catch The Blade". Enemies who attack you cannot roll additional dice with their Critical Hits.

levels.name: To Carry Their Fury
levels.text: After you reduce an attack's damage to 0 with Evasion, you may teleport adjacent to the attacker and Swiftly Skirmish them at no cost. After you make an attack and deal damage equal to a number you noted, you may remove any of your noted numbers to deal two additional damage for each removed.

techniques.name: Detective
techniques.flavor: Strong people like you tend to think that others will meet you with strength. But I've been taught differently. To topple a goliath, afford them no such luxury. Strike the vitals. Break their idiot stances. Research their flaws. Plan their death before they even know your name.

levels.name: Study Weakness
levels.text: After you Investigate a character, place a ‘Weak Point' in a space adjacent to them that doesn't have one. Your Investigations that target the same character are Swift this Turn. Weak Points move to match their host's movement. After you move into a Weak Point, you may remove it to ‘Jab', dealing [Mind/2] damage to its host. This counts as a Swift Skirmish, but cannot have its damage or targeting altered.

levels.name: Dissect [ Investigate x 3 ]
levels.text: The third Investigate has no Cost, and Slows all Marked Enemies.

levels.name: 4-Point Execution
levels.text: Whenever you move, you may teleport to a space an equal number of spaces away, so long as the teleport targets a Weak Point. After you remove 3 Weak Points from one target in a single Turn, you may teleport to any space adjacent to them and perform a Mind Finisher at no cost.

techniques.name: Drunkard
techniques.flavor: A little something to take the edge off~

levels.name: Down The Hatch
levels.text: Establish which direction is "up" after Deploying. After you Breathe, you may ‘Drink', Slowing yourself. Once per Turn, if you start or end your Turn while Slowed you must roll a d6, and move one space in a Line based on the result: 1: Up, 2: Right, 3: Down, 4: Left, 5/6: Any direction. When involuntary movement moves you adjacent to, out of adjacency with, or have your movement prevented by an enemy, you may deal [Tier] damage to them, up to once per type of trigger per enemy per Turn.

levels.name: Fool's Dance
levels.text: If you end your Turn while Slowed, gain Evasion equal to [Tier/2] + the number of Negative Effects on you.

levels.name: Chug
levels.text: The first Breathe on your Turn is Swift. After you Drink while Slowed,you Shred, Weaken, and Blight yourself. If you have 3 or more Negative Effects at once, you may ignore the effects of each. The movement from "Down The Hatch" can now trigger with any Negative Effect, and when triggered with two or more Effects it changes to "twice per Turn".

techniques.name: Master-At-Arms
techniques.flavor: You thought that was the last one?

levels.name: Multi-Faceted
levels.text: Gain the three following ‘Armaments'. Each one has a condition, and if you Skirmish while that condition is fulfilled you ‘Equip' it, replacing any Armament you had Equipped before. Each Armament can only be Equipped once per Turn. ‣ Blade: Skirmish while exactly 2 spaces away from an enemy and adjacent to none. This Skirmish is Swift. Before targeting, move one space. After resolving the Skirmish, Strengthen yourself. ‣ Pole: Skirmish 2 adjacent enemies. This Skirmish is Swift, and pushes your targets 3 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Launch your targets. ‣ Chain: Skirmish while exactly 4 spaces from your intended Target. This Skirmish is Swift and can choose a target 4 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Shred your target .

levels.name: Like Water
levels.text: The 2nd time you Equip an Armament each Turn, you gain 1 AP and Hasten yourself.

levels.name: Master At Work
levels.text: If you use a Talent Finisher while you have an Armament Equipped, you gain a bonus based on the Armament. ‣ Blade: Move two spaces ignoring characters. If you passed through the Finisher's Target, Mark and Launch them. ‣ Pole: This Finisher targets a 2 space Line drawn from your space. If this Finisher Spikes a Launched character, it gains an additional [Tier] Advantage and the spaces you targeted become Difficult Terrain. ‣ Chain: This Finisher targets all enemies in a 1x1 Zone centered on a space adjacent to you. For each Critical Hit you roll, that Zone expands by 1 space in every direction (1x1 > 3x3 > 5x5...) and deals one additional damage.

techniques.name: Crusher
techniques.flavor: It's said that to effectively counter an incoming blow, one would need five times the force to stop it. I assure you… I have that.

levels.name: 30,000 Tons
levels.text: Before you Skirmish, you may ‘Brace', making the Skirmish target no characters, Reinforcing yourself, and Taunting all adjacent enemies. If you Skirmish while Reinforced, you ‘Slam', dealing [Tension] additional damage and losing Reinforced.

levels.name: Hammerfall
levels.text: If you Slam after taking at least 5 damage before reductions since the end of your last Turn, you target all spaces adjacent to you instead of your normal targeting and Weaken all targets.

levels.name: "You Look Like A Nail"
levels.text: If you Slam after taking at least 10 damage (before reductions) since the end of your last Turn, you deal an additional [Body] damage.

techniques.name: Giant Frame
techniques.flavor: Woah. You're bigger in person. Like. Way bigger. Oh right, the armor. Right away sir!

levels.name: Big Arms
levels.text: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target each character in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

levels.name: Immense
levels.text: Gain [Body] additional maximum Health. You may take up a 2x2 section of spaces rather than one space when you Deploy. If you do so, you may freely move through 1x1 enemies and Obstacles.

levels.name: Shockwave
levels.text: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target all spaces adjacent to you, deal half damage, and have it Launch its targets.

techniques.name: Iron Bodied
techniques.flavor: Mushir Ahmed has a reputation for his displays of confidence. Most famous is his armor: It covers his legs and arms, but leaves his chest bare. It baffles advisors and opponents alike.

levels.name: Tough As Stone
levels.text: You can never have a Speed lower than 3 and can always move using your own Actions, ignoring all other rules to the contrary.

levels.name: Resilience
levels.text: Gain [Body/2] Armor.

levels.name: Stainless Stride
levels.text: At the beginning of your Turn, you may Immobilize yourself. While Immobilized, you can never take more damage than 4 + [Tier/2] in one instance (after all forms of damage reduction).

techniques.name: Vanguard Defender
techniques.flavor: If I get hurt, don't stop running.

levels.name: White Knight
levels.text: You may Block Attacks that target allies within [Body] spaces. When you do so, you Teleport to a space adjacent to the target and become the target instead.

levels.name: Steel Angel
levels.text: The first Block you use each Round has no Focus cost and gives you [Tier] Armor after the Attack resolves until the start of your next Turn, if you're Blocking for your allies.

levels.name: Inspire Courage
levels.text: After you start movement by moving out of adjacency with an ally, they may move to a space adjacent to your new location and Reinforce.

techniques.name: Absolute Bastard
techniques.flavor: You're an expert at making strangers hate you, huh?

levels.name: Easy To Hate
levels.text: Gain 3 Focus at the start of each Scene. After you Investigate an enemy, you may spend 1 Focus to Taunt them.

levels.name: Bully
levels.text: Once per Turn, after you Taunt a character, you may move up to 3 spaces towards them. If you move into adjacency with them, Snare them and gain 1 AP.

levels.name: Add Injury To Insult
levels.text: Your Attacks against characters you've Taunted gain [Tier/2] Advantage.

techniques.name: Battle Jockey
techniques.flavor: One of the most fearsome gangs in Pantomime are the "Cavalry". Riding diesel guzzling steeds, they're known across the city for their "Night Rides", running down anyone in their way. Visitors be advised, the directors hold no responsibility for any Cavalry related injuries.

levels.name: Trusty Steed
levels.text: After Deploying, you may Summon a Mount NPC with a Tier equal to yours adjacent to you.

levels.name: Grasping Jaws
levels.text: After your Mount attacks an enemy, you may have it Taunt them.

levels.name: Roaring Entry
levels.text: Once per Scene for 1 AP, you may have your Mount "Roar". When it Roars, it Dazes enemies in 3 spaces of it, pushing them 2 spaces.

techniques.name: Grappler
techniques.flavor: Make way for Pantomime's blazing star! The killer king with the inescapable pin! The one, the only… Raphaël Blasé!

levels.name: Restrain
levels.text: After you Body Finisher, Snare your target. Characters you have Snared also count as being Taunted by you.

levels.name: Spine Breaker
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If you would Spike a single Launched character, you may teleport to a space adjacent to your target and change the attack you are using into a Body Finisher at no Cost.

levels.name: Finishing Move [ Body Finisher → Jump ]
levels.text: Instead of moving with this Jump, you and a target of the Finisher Disappear. At the start of the next round or when either of you're able to take another Action (whatever comes first) you both return to the board in the same spaces, Launching all other enemies in 2 range, and letting you Swiftly Body Finisher the initial target at no cost.

techniques.name: Juggernaut
techniques.flavor: His physique spoke to me. It said, ‘Get the fuck out of my way.'

levels.name: Wild Charge
levels.text: Before you Jump, you may move [Body] spaces instead of [Talent], may deal 30 damage to any Obstacles you move adjacent to, and move any number of characters you passed through or moved into adjacency with to a space adjacent to you.

levels.name: Violence
levels.text: Once per Round, after you move through characters using "Wild Charge", you may deal [Body / 2] damage to them and Launch one of them.

levels.name: "Eat Dirt!"
levels.text: After you Launch an adjacent character without Attacking, you may ‘Throw' them, moving them 5 spaces in any direction. If they end their movement adjacent to another character or Obstacle, deal [Body] damage to both and remove Launched from them.

techniques.name: Mollycoddler
techniques.flavor: Y'know, you should be thanking me. True love isn't just given, it's PROVEN through trials of character and moments of doubt. And this, this is the greatest trial you could face! You'll never get another chance like it~

levels.name: Lash
levels.text: When an ally is hit by an Attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Swiftly Cast, targeting the attacker regardless of range at no AP Cost (this cannot trigger Lash or have you Cast targeting yourself).

levels.name: Loving Rite
levels.text: When an ally is damaged, you may take [Tier] damage to reduce the amount they took by [Tier]. After you trigger this because an ally was attacked, you may Fear the Attacker.

levels.name: Devotion
levels.text: When you trigger "Loving Rite" and no other allies are Marked by you, you may Mark them. When you trigger "Lash" with an ally you've Marked, you may use a Finisher instead of Cast. Joel's Notes: Using Summons If you're creating a character who can use Summons or NPC actions it's important to familiarize yourself with the Narrator-side NPC rules on page 108.

techniques.name: Mundane
techniques.flavor: No tricks, no frills, no bullshit. Just sit ups, squats, and plenty of juice
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: For What The Spirit Lacks
levels.text: You now use ‘Tenacity' instead of Focus or AP, spending it in place of both. You start each Round of combat with 2 Tenacity + [Body / 2]. You can't gain Tenacity from anything other than this Technique. You can't use Cast or Spirit Finishers.

levels.name: Dig Deep, Stand Firm
levels.text: After you're the target of an Attack, gain 1 Tenacity. When you would gain Focus, you reduce the cost of your first Finisher that Round by the same amount (this includes the initial AP cost as well as any additional cost added that would normally be paid with Focus).

levels.name: In The Face Of The Beyond
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you target an adjacent enemy, you may spend 2 Tenacity to ‘Silence' them. Silenced characters can only move or Attack on their Turn, and their Attacks cannot apply or trigger any feature or effect other than damage. Enemies you Silence remain Silenced until they end their Turn outside of adjacency with you, or until the end of the Round (whatever happens first).

techniques.name: Rising Challenger
techniques.flavor: Two swordsmen lock blades, silhouetted by moonlight. The impact reverberates throughout the streets, blowing out a nearby streetlamp. One survivor lives on, regretting every second of it.

levels.name: Perfect Deflection
levels.text: After you perform a successful Clash, you gain 1 Focus and can move [Tier] spaces.

levels.name: "You'll Have To Get Through Me!"
levels.text: You may Clash with Attacks that target allies within [Spirit] spaces. Before you Clash, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the character who initiated the attack.

levels.name: Drama And Spite
levels.text: Gain 2 Advantage in Clashes. Your Spirit counts as being 2 higher while in Clashes

techniques.name: Shield Bearer
techniques.flavor: They stood their ground. A breathing, bleeding wall between the people they had sworn to protect, and the coming darkness.

levels.name: Wall
levels.text: Before you Block, you may spend 1 Focus to gain [Tier / 2] additional Armor, and retain the Armor until you take another reaction, or you start your Turn.

levels.name: Shield Charge
levels.text: After you Block, place a ‘Shield Marker' in a space adjacent to you until you create another one. The Shield Marker moves to match your movement. If your movement would move your Shield Marker into an opponent's space, you may remove the Marker to deal [Body] damage to them and push them 2 spaces.

levels.name: Focused Defense
levels.text: While you have a Shield Marker, indicate a 3×3 Zone centered on it. If an attack would resolve against you while the attacker is inside that Zone, they're Weakened for the duration of the Attack.

techniques.name: Stalwart Sentry
techniques.flavor: Nothing gets past me, at least not in one piece.

levels.name: Guardian
levels.text: So long as you haven't moved during your Turn, the spaces diagonally surrounding you count as being adjacent when it would benefit you.

levels.name: On Watch
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Vigilance', a 4 Segment Clock that's filled at the start of every Scene. You may empty one Segment of this Clock when using Punish to have it not cost Focus. After you Charge, you refill the Vigilance Clock.

levels.name: Zone Of Influence
levels.text: After you Investigate, you may place up to 4 ‘Spotlights' in unoccupied spaces on the board. A Spotlight is a unique piece of Difficult Terrain that only affects enemies. When an enemy enters a Spotlight, you may teleport to an adjacent space and Punish them as if they left adjacency with you.

techniques.name: Bestial Ascendant
techniques.flavor: Don't worry, this happens to everyone your age.
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Beastly
levels.text: Choose two NPC Types. Once per Scene, after you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away and restoring [Body x 2] Health. While Transformed you can use your NPCs' Attacks, said Attacks lose any additional damage from Tension. After you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Inheritance
levels.text: Choose one of the two NPCs you chose when gaining "Beastly". You gain that NPC's Passive while Transformed, and use their on Deploy effects when you Transform. If the Passive triggers when the user is Knocked Out, it triggers after you end your Transformation instead.

levels.name: Apex
levels.text: While you're Transformed you can use your NPCs' Actions by spending 1 AP. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

techniques.name: Guard Caller
techniques.flavor: Tybalt's Faerie is a strange thing, stays hidden whenever it can. Its ability to shield and mend is invaluable for a guard, but he worries something's wrong with it, with every beast they fend off it stares at the body longer, and when tensions rise he swears he hears sobbing.

levels.name: Two Bodies
levels.text: You can Block when other characters are attacked, granting that character any Armor you would gain and preventing any forced movement they'd receive. When you would Block for an ally without a ‘Guardian' marker, first create one in a space within [Spirit] range. Unless the Guardian is adjacent to the attacker or the target when you Block, the Block is canceled. If you move while you have a Guardian you may move them the same distance.

levels.name: Together In Life
levels.text: Allies who start their Turn adjacent to or in the Guardian's space are Reinforced, enemies who do the same are Marked.

levels.name: Together In Death
levels.text: Your Blocks for allies have their focus cost reduced to 1 and gives [spirit] armor instead of [body].

techniques.name: Mecha Pilot
techniques.flavor: Runic alignment complete. Aether levels nominal. We got this partner. For Oberooooon!

levels.name: Rune Core Engine
levels.text: Once per scene, when you attack an enemy you may Summon your ‘Mech' to assist you, making the attack deal [Tier] additional damage and placing it adjacent to the target, with it pushing any characters in its space adjacent to it or as close as possible. The Mech is a 2x2 NPC with no Type, 15 Health, and [Tier/2] Armor that cannot take Turns. By Interacting with it, you ‘Pilot' it. This removes the NPC, grants you [Tier/2] Armor, and makes your character 2x2 in size. You may use Interact again to leave, losing these benefits and placing the Obstacle adjacent to you in sufficient empty spaces.

levels.name: Autonomous
levels.text: The Mech can now take Turns and is changed to a non- Modifier NPC of your choice with a Tier equal to yours and a minimum of [Tier/2] armor. While your Summon takes its Turn, you may Skirmish a character adjacent to it (regardless of range) in place of one of its Attacks.

levels.name: Perfect Sync
levels.text: You may start scenes Piloting. Even while you are in the Suit, it may still take Turns as a Summon, sharing your space and moving you when it moves. While you are in the Suit, the Summon is Dazed.

techniques.name: Analyst
techniques.flavor: What's my game? You seem confused. Why play games with you when I've already won?

levels.name: Flash Of Insight
levels.text: Once per Round, after any Roll from an enemy or willing ally, you may spend 1 Focus to force its initiator to redo it.

levels.name: Take Advantage
levels.text: When using "Flash Of Insight" against an enemy's Attack, the attack's target gains [Mind/2] Evasion.

levels.name: Watch And Wait
levels.text: After you investigate an enemy, you may spend 2 additional Focus to ‘Predict' them. The GM must tell you what actions they plan to use and the targets, if applicable. If that enemy does not take the action(s) described on their Turn, they are Dazed and Weakened at the end of their Turn.

techniques.name: Battle Instructor
techniques.flavor: Keep your back straight!" "Strengthen your footing!" "Remember the plan!" "..." "That was good, keep at it, kid.

levels.name: Strike Order
levels.text: After you mark a character, an ally of your choosing may move up to 3 spaces towards the character. Your Investigates are Swift.

levels.name: Teaching Moment
levels.text: When an ally is dealt a Wound, you may Investigate the character who Wounded them at no Cost as a Reaction.

levels.name: Remember Your Training
levels.text: Once per Turn per ally, when an ally moves adjacent to an enemy through the movement given by "Strike Order", you may have them deal their [Body/2] or [Talent/2] Damage to said enemy.

techniques.name: Empath
techniques.flavor: Don't worry buddy, everything'll be okay!

levels.name: Calming Aura
levels.text: Allies who start their Turn adjacent to you may lose any one of their Effects and become Strengthened.

levels.name: Protective Response
levels.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces takes a Wound or Effect from a source other than themself, you may Break Out at no Influence cost so long as it moves you adjacent to them.

levels.name: "Are You Ok?"
levels.text: Allies who start their Turn next to you gain 3 Focus and restore [Tier] Health.

techniques.name: Compassionate Sage
techniques.flavor: When allies falter, your presence is the whispered promise of safety.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Strength Of Prayer
levels.text: You now use ‘Compassion' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with [Spirit] Compassion. You can't gain Compassion using Breathe or Charge. You gain 1 Compassion after you target an ally with an action or the effect of a Technique.

levels.name: Cleansing Light
levels.text: If you Cast targeting an ally, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, heal [Hits] Health to your target(s), and have all Effects of their choice removed from them.

levels.name: Grand Restoration
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher gains the effects of "Cleansing Light", and can target characters within 5 range. When using a Spirit Finisher on an ally, they begin Regenerating and lose a Wound (Wounds can only be healed once per character per Scene).

techniques.name: Gourmand
techniques.flavor: Cooking is like painting or writing a song. Just as there are only so many notes or colors, there are only so many flavors—it's how you combine them that sets you apart.

levels.name: Healthy Meal
levels.text: You have [Mind / 2] ‘Meals' that refresh each Intermission. You may Interact to hand an adjacent ally a Meal, and Reinforce or Hasten them. When this Effect expires, the character finishes their meal, and restores 4 + [Mind] Health.

levels.name: Fast Food
levels.text: After you move out of adjacency with an ally, you may give them a Meal without Interacting.

levels.name: Shared Experiences
levels.text: When someone you're Bonded with eats one of your Meals, you both gain [Mind] Focus.

techniques.name: Surgeon
techniques.flavor: To blessed Hippocrates, I grant an offering. Let my hands remain steady and true. Let not guide this soul to Thanatos' waiting grip. This I swear. This is my Virtue.

levels.name: Do No Harm
levels.text: If you Skirmish an ally, you may ‘Operate' on them. When you Operate you must roll Mind instead of Talent or Body, and your target restores [Hits / 2] Health rather than taking Damage.

levels.name: Operational Procedure
levels.text: After you take this feature or after you take an Intermission, lose any ‘Bandages' or ‘Disinfectant', then roll [Mind / 2]. For every odd number rolled, gain one Bandage. For every even number rolled, gain one Disinfectant. After you Operate you may expend a Bandage to heal a Wound, and/or a Disinfectant to remove any number of Effects.

levels.name: Miracle Worker
levels.text: Gain 3 Advantage on your "Do No Harm" Skirmishes. If you roll two or more 1s or two or more 6s with "Operational Procedure", you may replace the resources gained by those dice with a ‘Miracle'. When an ally is Knocked Out, place a marker where they were. After you Skirmish targeting this Marker, you may expend a Miracle to bring the Knocked Out character back to that space, or an adjacent one if it's occupied, with full Health and 2 Wounds.

techniques.name: Tactical Master
techniques.flavor: Your ideas of combat are so limited. Here, let me paint you a picture of how far this canvas reaches.

levels.name: Stop And Think
levels.text: Anytime you are Weakened you enter the ‘Tactician Stance', removing any other Stances you had. While in the Tactician Stance, when your non-Attack Actions and Effects you apply deal damage, gain 1 Focus, up to [Mind] times per Turn.

levels.name: Study
levels.text: After you Breathe, you may Weaken yourself to gain 2 additional Focus.

levels.name: Eureka!
levels.text: After you start your Turn in Tactician Stance, you gain 1 additional AP, and your first attack on this Turn costs 1 more AP.

techniques.name: Talisman Exorcist
techniques.flavor: Every surface is covered in small, intricately detailed papers. This sort of obsessive protection seemed silly to her, but when removing one of these seals resulted in voices echoing around the room, she reconsidered.

levels.name: Sacred Seal
levels.text: If you Breathe, you may replace its effect with placing a ‘Talisman' on an adjacent target. Spaces and characters with Talismans are always valid targets for your Casts, and after you Cast targeting them, you gain 1 Focus.

levels.name: Tossed Talisman
levels.text: When using "Sacred Seal" you may place Talismans on targets within 5 spaces. After you Charge or Awaken this, you may activate "Sacred Seal" and repeat the effect once for each Focus you would have gained.

levels.name: Exorcize
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher can affect all targets with Talismans at once. Doing this destroys your Talismans and gives you 2 Focus for each.

techniques.name: Abjuring Sage
techniques.flavor: A battle won unharmed is a flawless one.

levels.name: Barrier
levels.text: If you Cast targeting one or more allies, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, Reinforce them and create a ‘Barrier' between one of them and a space adjacent. Barriers are 5 + [Tier x 5] Health walls that move to match allies they were created for, and do not affect the targeting or movement of allies. After you create a Barrier it replaces all other Barriers.

levels.name: Impenetrable
levels.text: After you create a Barrier, extend it one space in both directions and give [Spirit / 2] Evasion to all allies adjacent to it.

levels.name: Block Beam
levels.text: After your Barrier would be removed or replaced for any reason, it ‘Fires' away from the character it was created for, dealing [Spirit] damage to all enemies in an infinitely long orthogonal Line.

techniques.name: Alchemist
techniques.flavor: Eye of newt and toe of frog. Wool of bat, and tongue of dog. Adder's fork and blind-worm's sting. Lizard's leg and owlet's wing. For a charm of powerful trouble. Like a hell-broth: Boil and bubble.

levels.name: Quick Mix
levels.text: After you Breathe, you can make one of the following ‘Potions'. You can Interact to use one of these Potions on yourself or a character within 4 range. 1: Pure Water: Remove any Effect(s) from the target. 2: Fury Vapors: Strengthen the target. 3: Growth Serum: Begin Regenerating the target. 4: Adrenaline Stim: Hasten the target. 5: Stoneskin Balm: Reinforce the target. 6: Vilethorn Poison: Blight the target.

levels.name: Powerful Mix
levels.text: The first Interact you use on your Turn has its Cost reduced to 0. After you use a potion on an ally, they gain [Mind / 2] Focus. After you use a potion on an enemy, you may deal [Mind] damage to them.

levels.name: High Intensity Mix
levels.text: If you Breathe, you may replace its effects by triggering "Quick Mix" two more times, randomly determining each potion by rolling a D6, rather than choosing.

techniques.name: Dancer
techniques.flavor: The intimacy of combat is something that's difficult to recreate. That intoxicating passion has drawn more people together than you can possibly know.

levels.name: Dance Partner
levels.text: You can Interact with a willing character to set them as your ‘Partner'. You may only have one Partner and lose them if you end your Turn outside of adjacency. When one Partner moves willingly, the other may move to a space adjacent to them and gain Haste.

levels.name: Hearts In Tandem
levels.text: The first time a Partner Hides, or gains Focus each Turn, their partner gains any positive Effects or Focus they gained.

levels.name: The Prestige
levels.text: When a Partner uses a Finisher, their Partner may Daze themselves to have the finisher crit on rolls of 5 or 6, Teleport adjacent to the target, and use a Skirmish / Cast on the target. Using this effect makes the user lose their Partner status.

techniques.name: Fog Walker
techniques.flavor: When the fog rolls off the river Undine, the city streets are empty. For the darkened hunts would find those who do not flee, meeting those who carry a smile as easily as a blade.

levels.name: Blowing Smoke
levels.text: After you Breathe on your Turn, you may replace its effect with creating ‘Fog' in a space adjacent to you. At the end of your Turn, move your Fog up to 2 spaces in any direction. If you or an ally starts their Turn in Fog, they may Disappear. When a character Disappeared through this level reappears, they must do so in Fog, or as close as possible.

levels.name: Mystic Mist
levels.text: When a character reappears in Fog, they gain [Mind] Evasion and move up to 3 spaces.

levels.name: Stinging Steam
levels.text: Your Breaths are Swift. If you Stride you may replace its effect with moving your Fog Clouds up to 2 spaces and deal 2 damage to enemies every time a Fog Cloud passes through them.

techniques.name: Last Hope
techniques.flavor: He felt stupid. There it was, his face plastered on the gray brick in front of him. A blurry picture, but his face nonetheless. These posters must have been put up by someone he's helped, claiming he was some mythic savior. A reputation that would only make his life harder. What annoyed him most, though, was a certain someone now knew he wasn't going to stop.

levels.name: Notably Absent
levels.text: You may Assist at the start of any combat Scene regardless of your character's condition. If you Break Out while Assisting allies, you may give them an Effect based on the Action taken. The actions and effects are as follows: ‣ Stride: Hasten. ‣ Breathe: Reinforce. ‣ Investigate: Strengthened.

levels.name: Heroic Return
levels.text: At the start or end of any Turn where the Tension is 4 or higher, you may return to the board from your Assisting on any border space. After you return to the board, you gain all Positive Effects your allies have. These Effects can't be removed until combat ends.

levels.name: Explosive Return
levels.text: As soon as you return to the board, you may take a Turn, even if it would interrupt the Turn of an enemy. If this interrupted an ally's Turn, you must wait for them to finish.

techniques.name: Replicator
techniques.flavor: An infinite barrage of bullets and blades. A force that resembles an army but was born from a single hunter with a mage at their side.

levels.name: Echo Form
levels.text: If you Cast targeting only an ally or yourself, you don't deal damage or negative Effects. Instead, create an ‘Echo' adjacent to them. Echos are targetable pieces of Difficult Terrain with 1 Health. A character with an Echo may draw range from their Echos. You can only make 1 + [Tier] Echos at a time.

levels.name: Symmetry
levels.text: When a character with an Echo moves, they may move their Echo an equal number of spaces.

levels.name: Full Sync
levels.text: Characters with an Echo start the Round with 1 additional AP per Echo they have. Characters benefiting from this give Swift to their Attacks, so long as each draws its range from a different Echo.

techniques.name: Temporal Sage
techniques.flavor: Time until death: T- 2 minutes 4 days 10 days 2 weeks 1month 1.5 months 3 months 5 months 1year 5 years 6 years 6.5 years 10 years 25 years

levels.name: Accelerate
levels.text: If you Cast targeting an ally, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, they may move spaces equal to the damage you would have dealt, and then Hasten them.

levels.name: Decelerate
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. After you or an ally lose an Effect, you may spend 1 Focus to apply the same effect again.

levels.name: Time Stop
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Flux', an 8 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. After you apply an Effect to an ally, fill one Flux Segment. Once per Scene, after you start your Turn with a full Flux Clock, you may spend all your AP to empty it and Cast, targeting all characters in the Scene. If there are two or fewer enemies, you may take a Wound to go All Out and turn your roll against them into a Finisher.

techniques.name: Virtuoso
techniques.flavor: Doesn't it all seem to have a rhythm to it? When the bullets are flying and everyone else is in chaos, that rhythm guides me.

levels.name: Musician
levels.text: After you Breathe, gain a ‘Verse' of your choice from the list below. You can hold up to 4 Verses at a time (Including repeated verses). After you use Charge, you may expend all the Verses you are holding and grant the effects listed on them to characters in a 3x3 Zone placed adjacent to you. ‣ Harsh: Allies Strengthen and may move 1 space. ‣ Soothing: Allies gain [Mind / 2] Health. ‣ Inspiring: Hasten and give 1 Focus to allies. ‣ Raucous: Shred and deal 1 damage to enemies. ‣ Frantic: Allies may use a 1 Cost Utility action for free.

levels.name: Reverb
levels.text: Your Breaths are Swift. After you gain a Verse, you may immediately perform its effect on adjacent characters without spending it.

levels.name: Encore
levels.text: If you Charge with 3 or more Verses, you may forgo the Focus given to reduce its cost to 1.

techniques.name: Artist
techniques.flavor: The Ishtar Battalion has been described as "Avant-garde." Both meanings are equally accurate.

levels.name: Stroke Of The Brush
levels.text: You can Interact to ‘Paint' on an adjacent space in a ‘Color' of your choice. Each Color has a specific effect that triggers after you or an ally enters its space or starts their Turn in it for the first time in a Round. The Colors are as follows. ‣ Red: Strengthen yourself. ‣ Yellow: Teleport to another Colored space. ‣ Blue: Gain 2 Focus. ‣ White: Push any enemies in 3 spaces 3 spaces. ‣ Black: Pull any enemies in 5 spaces adjacent to you.

levels.name: Canvas Of Flesh
levels.text: The first Interact you use on your Turn has its Cost reduced to 0. After you Interact with an ally, you may spend 3 Focus to create a ‘Seal' on them, letting them gain the effect of one of your Colors every time they end their Turn.

levels.name: Brush-Brand
levels.text: After you Skirmish a character, you may ‘Brand' them with a Color of your choice. After you or an ally Attack a Branded character, consume the Brand and the attacker triggers the effect of the Color.

techniques.name: Deckbuilder
techniques.flavor: My father's deck has no pathetic cards!

levels.name: Draw
levels.text: After deploying, roll a die and set it aside. These dice are your ‘Cards'. After you Breathe with three or fewer Cards, roll a new Card. Before you Cast, you may spend any of your Cards to roll [Mind] instead of [Spirit], have it deal no damage to allies, and gain the Card's bonus. The bonuses for each are as follows: 1: Illness: Blights and permanently Slows the Target. 2: Star: Restore Focus equal to the damage dealt. 3: Night: The target Disappears and becomes Invisible. 4: Protection: Permanently Reinforces the target. 5: Union: Snare the target, Teleport adjacent to them. 6: Folly: Dazes, Immobilizes, and Launches the target.

levels.name: Card Capture
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you Investigate an NPC's Attack, you can roll a Card with all of that attack's non-damage effects. At the end of the scene, you can replace a Card in your deck with that Card. You can only replace up to 3 of your Cards like this at a time, and can return your default Cards at any time.

levels.name: Greed
levels.text: "Draw" has you roll double the Cards in all scenarios, and you may gain Cards by Breathing when at or below 5 cards instead of 3.

techniques.name: Will-O-Wisp
techniques.flavor: To most, a foul heresy. Artificial faeries, exploited by the non-keeper guards under Oberon. Yet despite the censoring of this practice, the number of "Royal Keepers" has recently been increasing far quicker than any Faerie population could possibly sustain.

levels.name: Spirit Weaving Flame
levels.text: After you Charge for the first time in a scene, you may create a "Spirit Flame" within 1 space of you, a marker that you can move up to 4 spaces after you Stride or end your Turn. It's pushed 1 space when its space, or a character in its space, is the target of an attack. When a character is standing on, or adjacent to your Spirit Flame, they count as having an effect. Choose an option from the list below to determine the effect: ‣ Dreamy Spirit: Enemies are Slowed. ‣ Angry Spirit: Enemies are Blighted. ‣ Insightful Spirit: Enemies are Marked. ‣ Intense Spirit: Allies are Hasted. ‣ Kind Spirit: Allies are Regenerating. ‣ Violent Spirit: Allies are Strengthened.

levels.name: Friendly Spirits
levels.text: When an ally moves out of your Spirit Flame, you may have it move to a space adjacent to their new position. When an enemy attempts to move out of your Spirit Flame, you may spend 1 Focus to stop their movement after they move out of that space, leaving them adjacent to the Spirit Flame.

levels.name: Twinned Spirits
levels.text: You may choose an additional option from "Spirit Weaving Flame". If you create a Spirit Flame you may create two, one of each type, or create one with the properties of both.

techniques.name: Bloodletter
techniques.flavor: I don't kill people, doctor. What I do is much worse.

levels.name: Bleeding Edge
levels.text: Your successful Skirmishes and Talent Finishers Blight the target(s).

levels.name: Bloodhound
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When a non-adjacent enemy takes damage from Blight, move up to 3 spaces. If it brings you adjacent, you may remove the Blight to Swift Skirmish them at no cost.

levels.name: Rupture [ Skirmish → Breathe ]
levels.text: If the Skirmish's target was Blighted, roll Talent and trigger the effect of Blight [Hits] times.

techniques.name: Chemist
techniques.flavor: Now there's a smell you can feel!

levels.name: Sublimation
levels.text: Your Improvises have their Cost set to 1 and can create an Obstacle up to 4 spaces away. When resolving an action targeting an Obstacle, you may destroy it to create a 3×3 Zone of ‘Gas' centered on its space that disappears at the start of your next Turn. When an enemy enters Gas, they are Weakened. Allies in the Gas gain 3 Evasion when they're the target of an Attack coming from outside the Gas.

levels.name: Experimental Mixture
levels.text: After you Weaken a character, you may ask the Narrator what its current Health is. If its at or below [Mind], that character is Knocked Out and you gain 2 Focus.

levels.name: Deposition
levels.text: After you create a Gas Zone, deal [Mind] damage to all enemies in the spaces it covers. After you Knock Out an enemy with "Experimental Mixture", create a 3x3 Gas Zone centered on them.

techniques.name: Constrictor
techniques.flavor: Whips, garrotes, nooses, you'd be surprised how many people are killed with glorified string.

levels.name: Wrap
levels.text: Your Successful Skirmishes with 1 target Snare the target. At the end of your Turn, you can move all characters you've Snared up to 5 spaces. You do not need to pull characters you've Snared after you move.

levels.name: Choke
levels.text: Your Body and Talent finishers can always target characters you've snared. Your Finishers deal [Tier] additional damage to Snared characters.

levels.name: Twisting Impact
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When "Wrap" moves a character into adjacency with other characters, they each receive [Talent/2] damage.

techniques.name: Cutpurse
techniques.flavor: It's an easy job. In and out. Bump into Āl-Amir just after sunset and slip your hand into his pouch. Be sure to apologize when he takes notice, and offer something by way of apology. Be polite, and he might not notice a missing satchel bag, or a knife in the back.

levels.name: Fast Hands
levels.text: Once per character per turn, after you leave adjacency with an enemy on your Turn, you may end your movement to do one of the following that you haven't already used this Turn. ‣ Disarm: Weaken them. ‣ Trip: Slow them. ‣ Steal: Gain 2 Focus.

levels.name: Snatch
levels.text: After you inflict certain Negative Effects on an enemy, you may gain its positive version. The Effects this applies to are as follows. ‣ Blight: Regenerate. ‣ Slow / Snare: Hasten. ‣ Shred: Reinforce. ‣ Weaken: Strengthen.

levels.name: Rob Them Blind
levels.text: If you used Hide on your Turn, you can use "Fast Hands" without ending your movement. Once per Scene, if you leave all spaces adjacent to the same character, you may Blight, Slow, Shed, Weaken, and deal [Tension] damage to them.

techniques.name: Light Bender
techniques.flavor: For hundreds of years the idea of keeping a ‘light' or ‘solar' faerie was seen as a fruitless pursuit. Not only was it not known if they truly existed, all theories came to the conclusion that such an elusive being could not be tamed by someone who had not made a faerie pact already. It's no wonder the first known keeper to achieve such a feat has performed so well among their peers.

levels.name: Blendendes Licht
levels.text: Your Casts and Spirit Finishers that Crit weaken one of their targets for each Crit rolled.

levels.name: Sonneneruption
levels.text: Your Spirit Finishers affect all targets in a 2x3 Zone centered on you, without targeting you (I.e. in the shape of a "C" around you), and Crit on rolls of 5 or 6 if at least one of the targets has a Negative Effect.

levels.name: Falscher Stern
levels.text: Once per Scene after you charge with at least 2 Tension, you may replace its effect with drawing a full 4 Segment ‘Solar' Clock, and placing a ‘Falscher Stern' marker within 4 range. At the end of your Turn or when an enemy moves out of adjacency with the marker, if you have a Solar Clock, empty one segment and Swiftly Cast at no Cost, targeting all enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on the Falscher Stern. If it was the last segment use a Spirit Finisher instead, removing the marker and the Clock.

techniques.name: Reaper
techniques.flavor: The people of the Gardens knew well to put out their offerings at solstice. For as the days grew long, the Harvesters of Krouses would make pilgrimage, seeking homes lacking piety to become their bloody crop.

levels.name: Sow
levels.text: After you Skirmish one Character, you may Teleport them to another space adjacent to you. The first time you use this each Turn, you Mark your target.

levels.name: Tend
levels.text: Enemies in 3 range don't lose Marked when they're hit (they still only trigger once per Turn).

levels.name: Reap
levels.text: If you start your Turn in 5 range of a Marked enemy, you may spend 2 Focus to Teleport to a space adjacent to them and use a Finisher on them at no cost. If you are then in 5 spaces of another Marked enemy, you may repeat this effect at a Focus cost of 1, using a Swift Skirmish instead of a Finisher. This cannot target the same enemy more than once per Turn.

techniques.name: Street Fighter
techniques.flavor: Who's lookin' to scrap?!

levels.name: Bloody Brass
levels.text: After you Shove a character, Daze them.

levels.name: Break And Bruise
levels.text: If you Skirmish a Dazed character without using a Technique with the Weapon Tag, it has Advantage equal to the number of different Effects on your target.

levels.name: Brutalize
levels.text: You may now trigger "Break And Bruise" when targeting Dazed enemies with Body Finishers. The Finishers convert all Advantage from it into additional damage, in addition to Immobilizing and Snaring their target(s) after damage is dealt.

techniques.name: Autophage
techniques.flavor: The Students of Mardrus were widely renowned in their day, creating the doctoring profession as we know it. Such a shame their achievements were overshadowed by the human cost of their work.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Transfusion
levels.text: You no longer use Focus. Any increases to your starting Focus increases your max Health instead. If you would spend, or lose Focus, use 2 Health per Focus instead, if you would gain Focus gain an equal amount of Health instead, any of this healing that would be prevented reduces the Focus cost of your next Finisher by the same amount. After you Attack a character with two or more different Effects, begin Regenerating.

levels.name: Overexert
levels.text: After you Attack, you may take 5 damage to roll a D6. Apply an Effect to your target based on the result of the roll. If you have 5 or less Health, you may use this without taking damage. 1-2: Blight 3-4: Daze. 5-6: Immobilize.

levels.name: Born Of Mutable Flesh
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you use a Spirit / Body Finisher, you may trigger "Overexert" twice and change the Finisher's targeting to all enemies with more Health than you.

techniques.name: Earth Speaker
techniques.flavor: I don't think you understand the gravity of that move. You lost the moment you touched the ground.

levels.name: Stone Soldiers
levels.text: As you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher, you may move an Obstacle adjacent to you into a space adjacent to your target. Doing so destroys the Obstacle after the Attack. If there are no Obstacles within 3 spaces of you when you deploy you may create up to 2 of them with 10 health adjacent to you.

levels.name: Tectonic Shift
