levels.text: After you move another character or an Obstacle you didn't create, you create an Obstacle with 10 Health in the space it left. Using Stone soldiers gives the triggering attack 3 Advantage.

levels.name: Earthen Shards
levels.text: After you destroy or move an Obstacle, you may deal [Spirit] damage to an enemy adjacent to its new or previous position. Each enemy can only be damaged by this effect once per Turn.

techniques.name: Strongman
techniques.flavor: Mom always said the best way to move people is with words, but picking up that bus seemed much faster.

levels.name: Strong-Arm
levels.text: If you Shove, you may move your target up to 5 spaces in a Line instead of 1 space, pushing any characters it would move through to the nearest possible unoccupied space. If you push them adjacent to an opponent, you may Launch all characters involved. You may target Obstacles with your Shoves.

levels.name: Piston Fist
levels.text: After you Skirmish or Body Finisher a character, you may push them [Body - Target's Armor] spaces.

levels.name: Smash Through
levels.text: After you move a character into adjacency with an Obstacle, both take [Body] damage. If the Obstacle is destroyed, the character is pushed for another 3 spaces. This additional movement can only be triggered once per move.

techniques.name: SwarmKin
techniques.flavor: I could see them wriggling under his coat, and the glare through his glasses didn't help me feel safer. They tried to explain the mission to me but I could barely pay attention. There were times where… something crawled across the ground out of sight, and the conversation would suddenly stop. Getting shivers thinking about it...

levels.name: Fluttering Form
levels.text: After you end your Turn or are the target of an Attack, you may spend 1 Focus to release a "Swarm" in either your space or the attacker's. Swarms are a unique Field. They stop enemies who move into them like Difficult Terrain, deal [Tier] damage to enemies who move into or start their Turn in the Field, and can be attacked and destroyed as if they were Obstacles with 1 Health. After you start your Turn, you may move each of your Swarms up to 3 spaces.

levels.name: Vanish Into Flies
levels.text: After you Disappear you may also create 3 Swarms within 2 spaces of the space you left.

levels.name: Devour
levels.text: When an enemy would take damage from a Swarm while two or more other Swarms are within 2 spaces of the enemy, you may remove those additional Swarms from the board to Blight the enemy who took damage and deal [Tier x 2] damage to them.

techniques.name: Siren
techniques.flavor: Lure and tempt. Free them all of their inhibitions. Show them that the world holds better things for both you and them, before you rip it all away.

levels.name: "You wouldn't hurt ME, would you?"
levels.text: Gain 3 Focus at the start of each Scene. After you Investigate an enemy, you may spend 1 Focus to Fear them.

levels.name: "I'm Irresistible!"
levels.text: Once per Turn, after you Fear a character, you may force them to move up to 3 spaces towards you. If they move into adjacency with you, you may Daze them and gain 1 Focus.

levels.name: "A little help over here?"
levels.text: After you Spirit or Mind Finisher a character, you may have all enemies affected by Fear move their Speed towards your target and deal [Tier] damage to them if they're adjacent.

techniques.name: Wave Rider
techniques.flavor: Yvon was never known for much. Didn't make a fuss, didn't make enemies, and didn't make a name for himself. Yet there were places where his name was whispered in reverence. Old knights told tales of the boy most free. Never lingering, he appeared silently and passed through crowds like flowing water. Never chained down. No kings, no clients, no masters. Sometimes this reputation bothered him, he felt life could do with a little more attachment.

levels.name: Gentle Waves
levels.text: Your Casts that target one empty space are always Swift, and the first Cast you use on your Turn that fits this condition has no Cost. After you target an empty space with a Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may place a ‘Wave Seal' in that space, up to a maximum of 4 + [Tier] Wave Seals placed at a time. When a character (allies must be willing) start their Turn in or move into a space with a Wave Seal, you may remove it to do one of the following: ‣ Move them up to 2 spaces in a Line. ‣ Launch them.

levels.name: Momentous Waves
levels.text: After you move yourself or an ally with the effect of a Technique, the character who was moved deals 1 additional damage on their next Attack on their Turn, up to a max of [Spirit].

levels.name: Aqua Cage
levels.text: If an enemy has a Wave Seal in each of their adjacent spaces, you may remove those Seals to Launch, Daze, and Immobilize them. Each enemy can only be affected by this once per Scene.

techniques.name: Mind Breaker
techniques.flavor: Day Four: I still haven't seen any of my fellow keepers. It seems we've all fallen to the same curse. This fog goes on forever, and strange beasts accost me at every turn. My supplies are running low. I can only hope they're edible.

levels.name: "Where Are You?"
levels.text: When you Cast on your turn, you may have it deal no damage to one target, making them ‘think' they're Banished instead. Characters who think they're banished treat themselves as Banished on their turn until they take damage from a player.

levels.name: "Where Am I?"
levels.text: Your first Cast each Turn that uses "Where Are You?" is Swift. If you have two or more enemies Banished or who think they're Banished at the end of your Turn, you may move each of them [Mind] spaces. If two or more of them move adjacent to each other, you may force each of them to attack another adjacent enemy, dealing 2 + [their Tier] damage.

levels.name: "Who Are They?"
levels.text: If an enemy starts their Turn and all enemies are Banished or think they're Banished, create two ‘Dark Illusions'. Dark Illusions are NPCS that are always Banished, cannot be targets, and cannot be damaged, cannot take Turns, and are at your Tier. They count as enemies for using "Where Am I?".

techniques.name: Gale Strider
techniques.flavor: Feel my bite, my roar, and my racing heart.

levels.name: Growing Winds
levels.text: After you Cast targeting an unoccupied space or Jump, you may place a ‘Typhoon' that covers the target space / space you left, and all spaces adjacent to it, replacing all other Typhoons you've created. When a character ends their Turn in a Typhoon, you may push all characters in the Typhoon 1 space in the same direction.

levels.name: Updraft
levels.text: After you end your Turn you may move any Typhoons 3 spaces in a Line. Any characters who enter the Typhoon through this movement are pushed 1 space in the direction it is moving and are Launched if they are an enemy.

levels.name: Mountain Carver
levels.text: "Growing Winds" and "Updraft" can now move Obstacles as well as characters. If you move an Obstacle outside of a Typhoon, you may have it continue its movement until it moves adjacent to a character, dealing [Tier] damage to that character. If an Obstacle is moved to the edge of the board through this feature, it is destroyed.

techniques.name: Poacher
techniques.flavor: Just… one… more… step…

levels.name: Steel Jaws
levels.text: Your Skirmishes that target only empty spaces, are Swift. After you target only an empty space with a Skirmish or Mind Finisher, you may place a ‘Small Trap' in that space. When an enemy moves over a Small Trap, their movement is stopped, they're Slowed, and you may swiftly Skirmish them regardless of range at no Cost. Doing this removes the Trap.

levels.name: Far Setting
levels.text: Your Skirmishes that do not target characters have an additional 3 range. Your Skirmishes that come from "Steel Jaws" Immobilize your target.

levels.name: Pit Trap
levels.text: If you set a 2x2 area of Small Traps, you may convert them into a "Pit Trap", changing the area into Low Terrain and combining the 4 traps into one "Giant Trap". Giant Traps function identically to Small Traps except they let you use a Mind Finisher on the target instead of a Skirmish.

techniques.name: Jailor
techniques.flavor: Look at where you're standing. Perhaps it's more accurate to say you "were" winning. In the afterlife, practice your situational awareness.

levels.name: Erect
levels.text: After you Breathe, you may place a ‘Pillar', a unique kind of "High Ground", on a space within 4 range. After you Charge, you may attempt to connect 3 or more Pillars you've placed with Lines to form a polygon, and then Spirit or Mind Finisher targeting all enemies in this polygon (including those on its lines) at no cost. This removes the Pillars.

levels.name: Readjust
levels.text: Before connecting the lines when using "Erect", you may Teleport any/all of your Pillars up to 3 spaces in any direction.

levels.name: Prison Of Your Own Design
levels.text: After you use the Charge portion of "Erect", you may leave the lines on the board until you next use it. The spaces these Lines cover are Difficult Terrain for opponents.

techniques.name: Worldsmith
techniques.flavor: It's a bit dirty out here for a fight don't you think? Let's take this somewhere a little more… orderly.

levels.name: Gaze Deeply
levels.text: Before you Charge, you may forgo the Focus you would gain to Immobilize an enemy in a range equal to the Focus you would have gained.

levels.name: Domain Of Control
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you inflict an Effect, to a character you may Teleport them and yourself to any space in your ‘Inner World', a separate 3x3 board that no other characters have access to. Once you K.O. them or they deal a Wound to you, you Teleport all living characters in your Inner World to a space on the edge of the normal board.

levels.name: Home Turf
levels.text: While in your Inner World, you gain [Tier] Advantage on all attacks and Duels (this feature carries over to the Duel despite it not being combat). "Domain Of Control" is now [Spirit] times per Scene instead of once per Scene.

techniques.name: Bombardier
techniques.flavor: Explosion!

levels.name: Explosion!!
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher can now choose a target in 4 Range and all targets adjacent to it instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Explosion!!!
levels.text: If you spend 2 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may have it choose all targets in a 3x3 Zone centered on a space within 5 range. Your Spirit Finishers gain 1 advantage per empty space it targets (to a maximum of [Tier +2] Advantage).

levels.name: EXPLOSION!!!!
levels.text: If you spend 4 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may have it affect all targets in a 5x5 Zone centered on a space within 6 range.

techniques.name: Eradicator
techniques.flavor: No, No, NO! Try showing me up when reduced to ash!

levels.name: Proliferate
levels.text: Before you Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to ‘Rapid Fire' instead. While Rapid Firing, you roll damage before targeting (meaning you cannot be affected by things that apply advantage / disadvantage when targeting) and may divide all damage dealt between any targets within 5 range. You don't need to divide this damage equally.

levels.name: Scorched Earth
levels.text: After you deal damage to an empty space, you may turn it into Difficult Terrain. The first time enemies move into or start their Turn in Terrain you created each Turn, they receive [Tier] damage.

levels.name: Endless Fire [ Charge → Cast ]
levels.text: The Cast gains Advantage equal to the number of different enemies within 5 spaces of you + [Tension].

techniques.name: Ritualist
techniques.flavor: Glyphs intertwine, paths converge—within this mesmerizing dance of foci, magic finds purpose.

levels.name: Ley Lines
levels.text: After you Charge, you may place a ‘Spell Circle' in your current space, removing any you've already created. When in a Spell Circle space, your Spirit Finishers can target enemies in 5 range.

levels.name: Arcane Artillery
levels.text: When affected by a Spell Circle, your first Spirit Finisher each Turn has 3 additional range and gains [Tension] Advantage.

levels.name: Fractal Etchings
levels.text: If you Charge while on a Spell Circle, you may enhance it for the Scene, doubling the effects of "Arcane Artillery". A Spell Circle can't be enhanced multiple times.

techniques.name: Spellcrafter
techniques.flavor: Everyone thinks an idiot of an innovator.

levels.name: Experimentation
levels.text: Gain one of the ‘Augments' listed below. You start every Scene with [Mind] ‘Innovation' charges, and may spend one of those charges before you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher to apply an Augment you have. These bonuses are as follows: ‣ Dire Augment: Damage dealt by this attack is increased by [Mind]. ‣ Focused Augment: This attack now affects all targets in a 5 space Line adjacent to you. ‣ Wild Augment: This attack now affects all targets in a 2x2 Zone within 3 range. ‣ Salient Augment: The range, and the length of lines created by this attack, are increased by [Mind].

levels.name: Solidification
levels.text: Gain an additional Augment. You no longer have Innovation charges and may use Experimentation by spending 1 Focus. Your starting Focus is increased by [Mind].

levels.name: Finalization
levels.text: Gain an additional Augment. You may apply two different Augments to any Cast or Finisher so long as you pay for both.

techniques.name: Student Of Stars
techniques.flavor: Feel the power flow into you, the ears ring with pops and snaps, the forearms go numb and the feet are rooted, with the earth below being your last resort in case everything else goes wrong. Remember your teachings and chants, only when every single one fails will you really know what you're capable of.

levels.name: Power Unleashed [ Charge → Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher has its Cost reduced to 1. While you use this Finisher, you may spend up to [3 x Tension] Focus.

levels.name: Formless Strength
levels.text: If you use "Power Unleashed", you may have it affect all targets in an ∞ length Line or a 2x2 space Zone adjacent to you.

levels.name: Moment Of Truth
levels.text: If you enter a Duel with 6 or more Focus, you may expend all of it to gain Advantage in that Duel, equal to half the Focus you spent.

techniques.name: Blade Smith
techniques.flavor: My spirit was focused, ready. I have honed it into a sharpness few things have ever known. It is almost disappointing that most will only see it once.

levels.name: Call Arms
levels.text: Choose a Technique with the "Weapon" Tag that you don't have, it's added to your ‘Arsenal'. After you Breathe or Charge, you may ‘Forge' a number of Techniques from your ‘Arsenal' equal to the focus gained. Before you Cast, you may spend a Forge to gain the 1st level of its Technique during the Cast, and make the Cast count as a Skirmish as well.

levels.name: Blade Storm
levels.text: Add another Weapon Technique to your Arsenal. After you start your Turn with 2 or more Forged Techniques, Strengthen yourself and make your first Cast of that Turn Swift.

levels.name: Saintly Sword, Excalibur
levels.text: Add a Weapon Technique to your Arsenal. If you Finisher while Strengthened, it targets an enemy within 5 spaces, can use "Call Arms", provides all three levels of the Technique(s) chosen, and counts as a Body / Talent AND Spirit Finisher.

techniques.name: Dramaturge
techniques.flavor: Why so glum, you're living in hallowed times! I've even graced you with my presence! Enjoy it while you can!

levels.name: All Eyes On Me
levels.text: Once per Action, after you roll a Crit for any reason, you may spend 1 AP or 3 Focus to ‘Elevate' the roll. If you Elevate, describe how your character adds some dramatic flair or additional detail to the roll they're taking and increase the Tension by 1.

levels.name: Snatch Their Fire
levels.text: If you increase Tension, create ‘Drama' instead. Drama counts as Tension on player Turns, but does not increase Tension on enemy Turns.

levels.name: Power In Presentation
levels.text: After you Elevate specific actions, they receive a bonus: ‣ Finisher: Deal [Tension] additional damage (counting the Tension added via Elevate). ‣ Charge: Gain AP equal to the AP spent on this Action (not including AP spent on Elevate). ‣ Cast: You may Mark, Immobilize, Taunt, or Fear your target. If multiple Crits were rolled, choose one additional option for each Crit.

techniques.name: Feral Arcanist
techniques.flavor: Magic isn't a thing you own, you don't create it and you aren't its master. The magi borrow from something greater than themselves, it's only natural that I return the favor once in a while.

levels.name: Vorpal Claw
levels.text: Your Cast can now only target one character within 2 range and Snares the target. This overrides any range or targeting modifiers or replacements outside this Technique. You may Roll Body instead of Spirit for Cast's Roll.

levels.name: Unchain [ Charge → Interact]
levels.text: If Interact targets you, begin tracking ‘Fury', a 6 Segment Clock, and fill one Segment for each adjacent enemy + [Tension]. If you have Fury Segments, you can only spend AP on Jumps & Finishers, and doing either empties one. In Fury, Jumps are Swift, and after you Jump, Swiftly Cast at no Cost, targeting ALL adjacent targets. When Fury empties, remove it, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Grasp
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. If you have at least 1 Fury Segment and you use a Body Finisher, you may spend all your Fury Segments to gain [Tension] Advantage and move up to 3 spaces before targeting.

techniques.name: Flame Heart
techniques.flavor: What approached me in that moon-lit pavilion was no elf, the way their eyes glowed was unnatural, the flames that licked from the ground to their legs, it felt too practiced, and the way they bled looked almost like they wanted this to happen.

levels.name: Rev Up
levels.text: After you Breathe you may ‘Ignite', receiving up to 6 damage and Blighting yourself to receive an additional Focus for every 2 damage taken. You receive half the damage from Blight.

levels.name: Damning Impact
levels.text: If you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher while Blighted, you gain [Tension] Advantage, and Blight your target. If you would Blight an enemy who's already Blighted, you deal [Tier] damage.

levels.name: Ashes To Ashes
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Your Spirit Finisher has a range of 5 and removes Blight from its target and yourself after targeting. If it removes any Blight, it additionally targets enemies in two crossing, diagonal 5 space Lines centered on the target in the shape of an "X".

techniques.name: Frost Veiler
techniques.flavor: Each incantation is a flurry of frozen elegance, conjuring storms of ice and swirls of snow.

levels.name: Chill
levels.text: Your successful Casts Slow your target(s).

levels.name: Icicle Halo
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Begin tracking "Icicle", a 4 Segment Clock that empties after each Scene. Once per Action, after you gain Focus, fill one Segment. Before you Breathe, you may replace its effect with emptying the Clock, dealing [Spirit/2] damage to a character within 5 range for each Segment emptied. If this damage targets a Slow character, Immobilize them.

levels.name: Shatter
levels.text: Your Spirit Finishers can target enemies in 5 range. After you use a Finisher on an Immobilized character, the Narrator must tell you their Health, if their Health is equal to or lower than [Spirit], you knock them out. After you KO a character using "Shatter", Slow enemies within 3 spaces of the target.

techniques.name: Grim Ascendant
techniques.flavor: It started from the extremities furthest from his heart. Beat by beat, Otes lost feeling in his fingers and toes. After legs came his sight, he must rely on his instinct. And finally it enveloped him, a dark blessing, perversion of the natural world, an exploitation of his masters' teachings, and the only chance he had left.
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Impermanent Power
levels.text: Once per Scene, after you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', gaining 1 AP, pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away, and losing your Focus and all but 1 Health, converting both into ‘Corruption'. Corruption is an alt Focus that goes "over" Focus and Health, being lost and gained in place of both, but can't be reset by other Techniques. While Transformed, your first Cast each Turn is Swift. After you're reduced to 0 Corruption, you lose the Transformation and become Dazed.

levels.name: Drain Life
levels.text: After you use a Spirit Finisher while transformed, you may begin ‘Draining' your target, Immobilizing yourself and the target until the start of either of your next Turns. If neither of you take damage before the effect is lost, you gain [Spirit] Focus.

levels.name: Umbra
levels.text: After you lose your Transformation, you may use a Spirit Finisher targeting yourself and enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

techniques.name: Ranger
techniques.flavor: Eros, a $20k compound bow custom-made for easy disassembly and shots from a distance upwards of 2000 meters. It boasts a draw of 200 lbs and the ability to pierce military grade armor. It's Mayflower's calling card, and one of the few things that proves they ever existed.

levels.name: Nock The Arrow
levels.text: Gain a new Action, ‘Prepare'. Prepare costs 1 AP, is Swift, and gives you one ‘Prep'. Once per Turn, Before you Skirmish or Talent Finisher, spend your Prep to gain 2 additional range & Advantage for each Prep spent, up to a maximum of 6 Prep.

levels.name: Feather Step
levels.text: After you Prepare, you may move one space so long as you don't move adjacent to an enemy.

levels.name: Lord Piercer [ Prepare × 3 ]
levels.text: Gain 1 AP, and your next Skirmish or Finisher this Scene (can't stack) affects all targets in an adjacent Line with a length equal to its range. If said Attack targets a character at the attack's maximum Range or the edge of the board, the attack deals additional damage equal to the Prep spent.

techniques.name: Sword Caller
techniques.flavor: The Keepers of Lear had some of the strangest partners. The Faeries rarely take the shape of elves, seeming to prefer hounds and rodents. Their reputation for violence is worse than those animals they imitate.

levels.name: A Warrior's Reprise
levels.text: Your Casts gain 2 Advantage. Before you Cast without a ‘Sellsword' marker, first create one in a space within [Spirit] range. Your Casts only treat spaces adjacent to your Sellsword as being within range. If you move while you have a Sellsword, you may move them the same distance.

levels.name: Warrior's Fury
levels.text: Once per Round, after you gain Focus while you have a Sellsword, you may use move it [Spirit] spaces and ‘Spark' a character adjacent to it 1/2/3/4 times, based on if you gained at least 1/3/6/10 Focus. Sparks deals [Spirit / 2] damage to its target and count as a Swift Cast; other features cannot change a Spark's targeting or damage.

levels.name: Supreme Sellsword
levels.text: As you end your Turn, you may spend 6 Focus to replace your Sellsword with a Summoned DPS NPC of your choice at the same Tier as you, placed in the closest unoccupied space. At the start of your next Turn, it returns to being a Sellsword in the same space.

techniques.name: Void Soul
techniques.flavor: You've been told you're hard to notice, easy to ignore. If only they knew how right they were.

levels.name: Return To Nothing
levels.text: The first time you Dodge, are Banished, or move to the edge of the board each Round, you can spend 1 Focus to Teleport to another space on the edge of the board.

levels.name: Fade Away
levels.text: The spaces on the edge of the board and adjacent to enemies are always valid places to Teleport to or return to from being Disappeared.

levels.name: Hollow Heart
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Void', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. After you Teleport, become Banished, or Disappear, fill one Void Segment. After you Teleport adjacent to an enemy while the Void Clock is filled, you may empty the clock to ‘Drown' a character adjacent to you, Banishing both of you and letting you Spirit Finisher them at no Cost. You cannot fill the Void Clock on the same Turn you Drown a character.

techniques.name: Thunder Blood
techniques.flavor: Plenty of kids in this country have spent sleepless nights watching the White Hounds, sparks flying down mountains and trees, descending from the clouds. Inevitably they'll be told by those older and wiser that there's no such thing, and when I was that age I almost listened. Thank god I didn't, the wind against my face is so exhilarating at this height.

levels.name: Raiden
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Static', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. If you roll more Hits on any roll than you have Static Segments, Hasten yourself and fill a Static Segment, or two segments if at least one of those rolls were a Crit. After you fill this clock, empty it, Daze yourself, and Swiftly Cast targeting all enemies within 4 range.

levels.name: Energized Incantation
levels.text: After you Cast, you can empty a Static Segment to do one of the following: ‣ Blink: Teleport to a space adjacent to your target. ‣ Shock: Inflict Daze. ‣ Chain: Swiftly Cast a different enemy in 5 range of initial target at no cost (this cannot spend static).

levels.name: Tactical Discharge
levels.text: While you have at least 3 Static, Your Casts Crit on 5s or 6s. If you fill your Static Clock by casting or using a Spirit Finisher, you may Teleport to a space within 4 range before emptying it.

techniques.name: Zealot
techniques.flavor: The brass has sullied all we hold sacred! The machine is in the garden, and nectar coats its teeth!

levels.name: Heretical Devotion
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Insight', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. Once per Action, after you roll a 1 for any reason, you may spend 1 Focus to fill an Insight Segment. If you Charge, Cast, or Spirit Finisher, you may empty an Insight Segment to have your final Hit count treated as [Spirit + Tier] x 2 minus the number of Hits rolled.

levels.name: Freak
levels.text: After you start your Turn with 4 or more Insight Segments filled, you may Strengthen yourself and have every character inflict Fear on you.

levels.name: Never Meant To Be
levels.text: If you use a Spirit Finisher with a full Insight Clock, you may empty all the Segments to have it target two intersecting ∞ length lines anywhere on the board. All targets are moved one space off of the line in a direction of your choice and all spaces on the line are removed from the game, destroying any Obstacle on them or connected to them. If a character would enter one of these spaces, they are instead Teleported to the closest space on the opposite side of the Line.

techniques.name: Creator
techniques.flavor: This city is a heretical idol, incomplete, unstable, and fallen to vice. My men and I have tried to negotiate its salvation, but these creatures seem unable to save themselves. Be thankful we are so graceful.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Forming Signs
levels.text: You now use ‘Material' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with no Material. You can only gain Material using Breathe and Charge. If you make an attack with any amount of Material, you must spend all of them and gain an effect based on the number spent and the Attack used. 1-2 & Cast: Crossing Nails: Target two adjacent 3 space Lines where at least 1 space of each overlaps. 3+ & Cast: Impossible Mallet: Target every enemy exactly 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 spaces away from you (choose one), dealing additional damage equal to this number and making the spaces low ground. 1-2 & Finisher: Celestial Pile-Arm: Gain 2 Advantage. Your target is pushed as far as possible, and receives one damage for every space pushed 3+ & Finisher: Living Idol Gain 4 Advantage. Target up to 6 spaces adjacent to each other where one is adjacent to you, these spaces become high ground.

levels.name: One True World
levels.text: Your first Breath you use on your turn is Swift. Your Charge has its cost reduced to 1. After you deal damage to or destroy an Obstacle you gain a Material.

levels.name: Labor Of The Devout [ Cast → Finisher ]
levels.text: This Finisher counts as having spent an equal amount of Material as the Cast used before it.

techniques.name: Ego Arm
techniques.flavor: Two minds as one, united in a pursuit of glory.

levels.name: I Am Your Sword
levels.text: After Deploying or Breathing you may target an adjacent willing ally and ‘Equip' to them, making them your ‘Wielder'. While Transformed you take up your Wielder's space, you can use their attributes for rolls, you don't count as a target, and you can't move. If your Wielder takes a Wound you do too. Either of you can split at the start of your Turns, placing you in an unoccupied adjacent space.

levels.name: Show Your Targets
levels.text: You may move on your Turn while Equipped, moving your Wielder with you.

levels.name: And I'll Become Irreplaceable
levels.text: After you Equip, determine you and your wielder's highest combined Attribute (choosing between ties), and give both of you a feature based on what it is; Body: Heavy Arm: Before targeting with Finishers, move up to 3 spaces in a Line, dealing [Partner's Body] damage to enemies you move adjacent to. Talent: Bladed Arm: When moving, you ignore enemies and gain [Partner's Talent] Evasion if you moved through at least one enemy. Spirit: Ranged Arm: Your Finishers can target characters up to [Partner's Spirit] spaces away. When they target one character at that range exactly, they also deal [Your Spirit] additional damage. Mind: Complex Arm: At the end of your Turn Mark all enemies you attacked. After you attack a Marked enemy, gain [Partner's Mind] Focus.

outlooks.name: Rebel
outlooks.description: Those who've lost their belief in, and respect for, the authority above them. Be it The Rebel's immediate superiors or those completely out of reach.

gifts.name: Until My Last Breath
gifts.text: Whenever you gain Stress, you gain 3 Advantage on the next Body or Talent Roll you make in that Scene.

gifts.name: I'll Carry My Weight
gifts.text: You may use the Help and Protect Bond Actions targeting yourself, when you do you can't spend Stress and count as your own Rival.

gifts.name: Supernatural Deafness
gifts.text: You don't have an Ability, can't Cast in combat, and can't use supernatural equipment. You gain double the Advantage from any Bonds you use in Rolls and your max Stress is now 4.

gifts.name: Not Today
gifts.text: When you or one of your Bonds would take Stress from physical damage, you may become the target and nullify the Stress. Roll a die for each of the following questions that are answered with "yes" and take 1 Stress for each that doesn't Hit. ‣ Was the attacker a named character. ‣ Do you not have a bond with the attacker. ‣ Does the Narrator think the attack could KO you.

gifts.name: Overexertion
gifts.text: When you make a roll, you may go All Out by taking a Stress instead of spending Influence.

gifts.name: Leave This To Me...
gifts.text: When an ally is Knocked Out by another non player character, you lose all of your Stress and may Duel by taking 1 Stress instead of spending Influence until the end of the Scene.

gifts.name: Aggressive To A Fault
gifts.text: You may create any number of Quick Bonds in a Chapter, so long as all of them are immediately set as Rivals or Enemies.

outlooks.name: Loyal
outlooks.description: A person dedicated to, and participating in, the systems and authority of those in power. The Loyal's oath to this cause reaps benefits others could only dream of.

builtin.name: The Oath
builtin.text: This must be taken in addition to your two starting Boons if you choose "The Loyal" as your Primary Outlook. This Boon can't be taken after Tier one. You have an Oath, a single word that you embody. At any point the Narrator can invoke your Oath to ask you to act in a specific way. If you do so you gain 1 Influence.

gifts.name: Fish Out Of Water
gifts.text: Once Per Chapter, When you use Study while the target is doing something normally considered mundane or pedestrian, you may give the recipient one extra Influence.

gifts.name: Durandal
gifts.text: You've been entrusted with a massively important weapon or tool. Note what it is and what it excels in as if you were making a custom Skill. When your tool is applicable in a Challenge Roll, gain 2 Advantage and you may go "All Out" by gaining 1 Stress instead of using Influence.

gifts.name: My Master's Teachings
gifts.text: An NPC you've met or of your creation gains a Rank [Tier/2] Student Bond with you. Once per Chapter you may have them use the Teach Bond Action on you even if they are not in the Scene (you choose the Skill they offer you).

gifts.name: Law And Order
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, you may choose a character. The Narrator must then tell you the most notable crime they've committed (if any). You may also freely Quick Bond with them.

gifts.name: Secret Technique
gifts.text: When you use your Ability in a Roll you may spend 1 Influence to claim to use a "Secret Technique" taught by the people you swore your Oath to. When you do, you may force any NPC related to your Oath to use the "Help" Bond Action on you, even if they're not in the Scene.

outlooks.name: Light
outlooks.description: A provider, protector, or pacifist, and more importantly than any of that, a person to be depended upon. The Light naturally draws those in their darkest hour.

gifts.name: Saint
gifts.text: You have 2 Advantage on Rolls that relate to characters with no negative feelings towards you.

gifts.name: Friendly And Approachable
gifts.text: Your Quick Bonds with non-player characters start at Rank 2. You may also form more than one Quick Bond in a Chapter by taking one Stress when doing so.

gifts.name: Performance Artist
gifts.text: Choose one of your Skills, it gains an additional Rank. When you first get an Extreme Success with your chosen Skill in a Scene, anyone Bonded with you can remove 1 Stress.

gifts.name: North Star
gifts.text: Your "Help" Bond Actions give additional Advantage equal to your Bond Rank with the target.

gifts.name: Books And Their Covers
gifts.text: When you offer to befriend someone who's tried to hurt you before, you may spend 1 Influence to force the Narrator to either have them accept the offer or give you 2 Influence. If this is attempted on the same character more than once, the Narrator can deny it without giving you Influence.

gifts.name: Looking Our Best
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, you may spend 1 Influence to change to any new outfit you describe between Scenes, regardless of context. Willing allies who were with you can also do this at no cost. Characters in outfits that match their environment (eg. suits at luxury events) have all their Skill Ranks raised to a minimum of [Tier/2] for the duration of the Scene.

gifts.name: Perspective Of A Friend
gifts.text: Your Bonds with Partners always count as being 1 Rank higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Partner and you use Influence with them present for the first time in a Scene, they gain an Influence.

outlooks.name: Wolf
outlooks.description: A person scarred and scared, left behind by or who has left behind those they depended on most. The Wolf is a loner, though they're unlikely to stay that way.

builtin.name: Lone Wolf
builtin.text: This must be taken in addition to your two starting Boons if you choose "The Wolf" as your Primary Outlook. This Boon can't be taken after Tier one. You can only have 3 Bonded characters at a time, you always know where someone you're Bonded with is.

gifts.name: The One Thing You Can Rely On
gifts.en: The One Thing You Can Rely On
gifts.text: You may form Bonds with weapons as if they're characters. When you do so they're Rank 1 and Partners. Weapons made via an Ability all count as the same weapon.

gifts.name: Dark Urge
gifts.text: When you attempt to use your Ability in a Challenge Roll, you may gain 2 Advantage. If you roll an odd number of Hits, your Narrator can have you use a Skill or Ability on a character you weren't targeting, you can resist this by taking 1 Stress. Gain 2 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

gifts.name: Outgunned
gifts.text: When you're working against more enemies than you have allies, you gain 2 Advantage on all Rolls.

gifts.name: Loyal
gifts.text: When you only have 1 Bond, the Rank of that Bond is treated as being 2 Ranks higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum).

gifts.name: Brood
gifts.text: When you take Intermission and don't form or Rank Up any Bonds, You may also leave (if there is one central site) and tell the Narrator that you want to do something alone to gain 1 Influence. They can either describe how you succeed or force you to roll for it or play it out as a Scene.

gifts.name: Better Off Alone
gifts.text: When you Abandon a Bond of Rank 2 or higher, you may restore all of your Stress.

outlooks.name: Mentor
outlooks.description: Wise for your years, no matter how many, a towering beacon of experience and strength. Though maybe this isn't The Mentor's story to use this.

gifts.name: Old, Calloused Hand
gifts.text: Write two ‘Calluses', negative events that you've dealt with before, leaving you stronger. When you're presented with a Threat related to your Callus, you may lose 1 Stress.

gifts.name: Casual Excellence
gifts.text: Choose two of your Skills or a Skill and Ability. When you would Roll using one of these features to gain Advantage, you may roll a single die instead, getting a Failure on a roll of 1, a Minimum Success on a 2-5, and an Extreme Success on a 6. A Narrator may make you roll 2 dice and take the lower if the challenge would be exceptionally high.

gifts.name: An Organized Style
gifts.text: When you use your Ability in a way you've never used it before, you can give that specific usage a name to gain 3 Advantage.

gifts.name: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
gifts.en: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, your Ability can instantly kill any unnamed NPC standing in front of you regardless of context. If you ever use the effect of this Boon, you lose two Bond Ranks with a character of your choice. If you lose all of your Bonds, you lose control of your character permanently.

gifts.name: Perspective Of A Teacher
gifts.text: Your Bonds with Students always count as being 1 Rank higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Student and you use Influence with them present for the first time in a Scene, they gain an Influence.

outlooks.name: Apprentice
outlooks.description: Bright-eyed greenhorns looking to make up for the experience they lack and make a name for themselves. The Apprentice starts small, but holds big ambitions.

gifts.name: Never Give Up!
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, when you fail a Roll with immediate consequences, you may hold it back, drawing a 2 segment Clock instead. This Clock fills a segment when you Roll against something other than that Threat, or at the Narrator's discretion. The Threat resumes when the Clock fills, and you take 1 Stress (this is not self-inflicted Stress).

gifts.name: Amazing Potential
gifts.text: When you Roll for a Test with one or fewer sources of Advantage, roll an additional die. This is your "Star Die". If your main roll is a Failure, but your Die is a 5, it becomes a Minimum Success at the cost of 1 Stress. If it's a 6 the roll becomes an Extreme Success.

gifts.name: Still Getting Used To It
gifts.text: When you use your Ability to gain Advantage in a roll, roll a die. If it's even gain [Tier] additional Advantage from it. If it's odd, gain no Advantage from it. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on your Ability. When you would Awaken a Boon you may remove this one instead, and gain another 2 Character Ranks to spend on your Ability.

gifts.name: Plenty To Learn
gifts.text: Once per Scene, If a player you Study uses Influence in that Scene, gain 1 Influence.

gifts.name: A Step Behind, But Still Running
gifts.en: A Step Behind, But Still Running
gifts.text: When you Awaken in an unstructured Scene, you gain 3 Advantage on the next roll you make. Gain 2 Character Ranks that can only be used to Awaken.

gifts.name: Order And Out
gifts.text: While you're following any kind of order given by one of your Bonds, they may "Help" you, even if they're not in the same Scene.

outlooks.name: Accursed
outlooks.description: Doomed from the beginning, a being of ill fortune, granted power they never asked for. What is the power? How can they get rid of it? The Accursed rarely knows.

gifts.name: Volatile Blood
gifts.text: Your Ability ignores the "keeps one of the words contained in the original" restriction when swapping out its original words with new ones. Gain 3 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

gifts.name: Uncontrollable Power
gifts.text: Your Ability is now "You [Verb] [Noun] When You [Condition]", meaning it's always applied while the condition is fulfilled (or just always if there's no condition). When you expand your Ability choose if those new words are your "default". If so they can trigger your Ability. Gain 3 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

gifts.name: Sacrifice
gifts.text: You may use this Boon after any Roll to make it an Extreme Success by sacrificing one of the following (It can't be restored, only replaced). ‣ Your eye. ‣ Your arm. ‣ Your leg. ‣ Your tongue. ‣ Your life.

gifts.name: Self Destructive Strength
gifts.text: When you use an Ability to gain Advantage on a Roll, but don't use either a Bond or a Skill, you may take 1 Stress to "Overload" your Ability and gain double the Advantage from it.

gifts.name: Tainted Body
gifts.text: One or more of your limbs or eyes are concealed from other people. Once per Series, when you spend Influence, you may reveal this part to gain 3 + [Tier] Character Ranks to spend on your Ability.

gifts.name: The Voice
gifts.text: Your Ability is sentient and speaks to you. It also counts as a Bond and can be used in rolls (unless you're using it as an Ability). When you only use your Ability in a roll you may ask the Narrator if it's compliant in the action you're taking. If they are, gain 2 Advantage, if they aren't, take 2 Disadvantage.

outlooks.name: Blessed
outlooks.description: Living in near-edenic plenty, a person granted fortune beyond imagination. Some combination of pride and ignorance is almost necessary for The Blessed.

gifts.name: A Web Of Connections
gifts.text: When you use Influence, you can identify an unnamed NPC in the Scene. You gain 2 Advantage on Rolls where that NPC is relevant.

gifts.name: Trust Fund
gifts.text: You have 10 ‘Funding Tokens'. When you make a Roll, you may spend any number of Funding Tokens to explain how you use your wealth to help you, gaining equal Advantage on the roll. Gain 5 more Funding Tokens when you Tier up.

gifts.name: Sick Ride
gifts.text: You have a 1-2 seating ground or water vehicle that you can create or call to you by taking 1 Stress or spending 1 Influence. When you do, choose a willing character to drive and answer the 3 following questions. The driver gets Advantage equal to the number of "yes" answers on all rolls that could use the vehicle for the duration of the scene. ‣ Are you in a large open area. ‣ Does the driver have experience with it. ‣ Is it the first time you used this in this chapter.

gifts.name: Social Setup
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, you can spend 1 Influence to claim you have connections in the place you're in or relating to what you're doing. When you do this, Roll Mind with Advantage equal to your Tier and set all Hits aside. Any time you're in a Scene with an unnamed character, you may claim that that person is part of this connection and gain Advantage on all rolls relating to them equal to the Hits you set aside.

gifts.name: Beck And Call
gifts.text: Gain a Rank [Tier/2] "Servant" Bond with an unnamed NPC you've met or one of your creation. Once per Chapter, you can call them into any non-combat Scene at will, and if they cannot show up; the Narrator must give you 1 Influence.

outlooks.name: Quiet
outlooks.description: Modest and unassuming people, with a life on the fringes, not concerned with image. Though it's hard to say how many of The Quiet would like a story of their own.

gifts.name: The Talent
gifts.text: Your once per Chapter Boons are now twice per Chapter.

gifts.name: Right Place, Right Time
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, when an ally is in a different Scene and you are not occupied, you may appear in that Scene. If said ally was making a Roll, they may go All Out once at no cost.

gifts.name: Eagle Eyed
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, when you speak to a character you were not with the Scene before, you may ask the Narrator one of these questions. ‣ Where did they come from. ‣ Were / Are they being followed.

gifts.name: Gearhead
gifts.text: You can make ‘Gadgets', using Character Ranks. They're treated as Abilities for their creation and usage in Rolls. Unlike Abilities, Gadgets are physical objects that can be given to, and used by other characters, though others can only gain up to 2 Advantage from using them. Your Gadgets can be permanently destroyed through the Risks you receive or by doing so yourself. Doing either refunds you any Character Ranks you spent on them. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on Gadgets.

gifts.name: Knacks And Hobbies
gifts.text: You gain 3 Advantage on all rolls that don't oppose or relate to another character.

gifts.name: Technobabble
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, when you see a supernatural item, you may ask the Narrator one of the following questions. Once in that Scene you can go All Out on a Roll relating to it at no cost. ‣ What does it usually do. ‣ How could it be disabled. ‣ Could I recreate its effects.

outlooks.name: Confident
outlooks.description: A person who must make themselves known, who fears a decline in image more than their death. Who wouldn't agree with The Confident when your life has eyes on it.

gifts.name: Spite
gifts.text: When you lose, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll, to a character you're Bonded with you may assign them as the target of your ‘Spite'. When you use that Bond to gain Advantage in any sort of competition, you may also Crit on rolls of 5. If the roll is an Extreme Success, that character is no longer the target of your Spite.

gifts.name: You're Strong…
gifts.text: When you lose to an Antagonist, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll, you may "put them over", showing how badly you lost and stating that they're your superior. Doing this lets you and any allies in the same scene from an Rival Bond with the Antagonist or upgrade an existing bond with them by one Rank.

gifts.name: Chatty
gifts.text: When you perform an Opposed Roll, you can begin talking, be it monologuing, quipping, taunting or ranting, gaining Advantage equal to your Bond ranks with your opponent. If you fail this roll, the opponent deals 1 additional Stress to you.

gifts.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
gifts.en: Do You Know Who I Am?
gifts.text: When you dramatically introduce yourself around unnamed characters, you may use this Boon to prompt them to: gasp, become interested in you, or make fun of you (Narrator's choice). When you get a reaction you haven't before, gain an Influence.

gifts.name: Perspective Of A Lancer
gifts.text: Your Bonds with Rivals always count as being 1 Rank higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Rival and you use Influence with them present for the first time in a Scene, they gain an Influence.

reference.name: Character Creation Checklist
reference.text: Choose a concept and Tier. Assign Attributes, choose Outlooks and Boons, spend Ranks on Skills and an Ability, then buy Technique Levels. Finish by recording your derived statistics.

reference.name: Starting Attributes
reference.text: Assign 4, 3, 2, and 2 among Body, Talent, Spirit, and Mind. Attribute growth and the Technique-Level conversion are handled by the builder.

reference.name: Starting Ranks
reference.text: A new hero starts with 8 Character Ranks. Spend at least 4 on Skills; the rest may be spent on Skills or an Ability. Ranks range from 1 to 3.

reference.name: Outlooks and Boons
reference.text: Choose a Primary Outlook and its inherent Boon, then choose two additional Boons from your selected Outlooks. Higher-Tier heroes gain more options in the builder.

reference.name: Technique Levels
reference.text: A new hero has 5 Technique Levels. Buy Levels in order within a Technique. The searchable Technique catalogue contains the complete LionWing text for every Level.

reference.name: Ability Formula
reference.text: Build an Ability from Verbs, Nouns, and Conditions. Its cost is calculated from the selected words and Rank. Symbol-specific exceptions are shown beside the Ability editor.

reference.name: Derived Statistics
reference.text: Health equals 10 + Body + twice Tier. Speed equals 2 + half Talent, rounded up; Focus equals 1 + half Spirit, rounded up. LionWing has no Guts statistic.

effects.intro: Effects represent ongoing benefits and statuses. Characters lose their Effects when they end their Turn unless stated otherwise. Effects can't be removed this way on the Turn they're applied. Applying an Effect a character already has counts as applying it on that Turn.

positive.name: Banished
positive.text: Non-Banished characters don't count as a target to you, you don't count as a target to them, and you can take up the same space as another object. Lose this Effect at the beginning of your Turn. When a character applies Banished, all other characters that have been Banished by them lose it.

positive.name: Hastened
positive.text: Your Speed is doubled. When moving in a way that doesn't rely on Speed, you may move twice as far.

positive.name: Disappeared
positive.text: You're removed from the board. You lose this Effect as you take any Action, start your Turn, or if an enemy spends 2 AP to search for you. After you lose this Effect, reappear on any space that isn't adjacent to a character. This does not count as movement.

positive.name: Invisible
positive.text: You may lose this to Disappear as a free Action or Reaction. This is not removed at the end of your Turn.

positive.name: Regenerating
positive.text: Restore 4 + [Tier] Health as you end your Turn. This is not removed at the end of your Turn.

negative.name: Blighted
negative.text: Lose [Tier] Health after you use an Attack. This is not removed at the end of your Turn.

negative.name: Dazed
negative.text: You start your Turn with 1 less AP.

negative.name: Feared
negative.text: Your Attacks that target the character who applied Fear to you have [Tier] Disadvantage. This is also removed when the Fearing character is Knocked Out.

negative.name: Immobilized
negative.text: You can't willingly move. You can't benefit from Evasion.

negative.name: Launched
negative.text: You can't take your Turn immediately after being Launched if an ally could take one instead, and you can't willingly move. When a Launched character is an Attack's target, the Attacker may Spike them, giving them [Tier] Advantage and removing Launched. This is removed after you start your Turn.

negative.name: Marked
negative.text: The first Attack that deals damage to you and can have its damage increased deals [Tier] additional damage and removes this. This is not removed at the end of your Turn.

negative.name: Slowed
negative.text: Your Speed is halved. When moving in a way that doesn't rely on Speed, you may move half as far.

negative.name: Snared
negative.text: When a character applies this, you're pulled adjacent to them. While your ensnarer is on the board, you can't willingly move; when they move, you are moved adjacent. You can't benefit from Evasion.

negative.name: Taunted
negative.text: Your Attacks that don't target a character who applied Taunt to you have [Tier] Disadvantage. This is removed when the Taunting character is Knocked Out.

actions.intro: These Basic Actions and Reactions are used in structured combat. Actions can only be used on your Turn; Reactions can be triggered when specified.
actions.combos: A Combo is a string of two or more Actions formatted as [X → Y] that grants a bonus when performed with no other Actions in between. Only one Combo can be executed per Action. If a Technique Level starts with a Combo, its effects only happen if that Combo is used. Combos can start off your Turn as long as you don't take an Action that would break them. After use, a Combo is on Cooldown until the end of your next Turn and can't be used while on Cooldown.

list.name: Jump
list.text: Move up to [Talent] spaces in a Line. This ignores opponents and Difficult Terrain.

list.name: Stride
list.text: Move up to [Speed] spaces. This movement can be saved and used after taking other Actions.

list.name: Cast
list.text: Choose a target within 5 range. Roll Spirit. Reward: Deal [Hits] damage.

list.name: Skirmish
list.text: Choose up to 2 adjacent targets. Roll Body or Talent. Reward: Deal [Hits] damage.

list.name: Finisher
list.text: Choose an adjacent target, spend up to [Tension] Focus, and roll any Attribute at that much Advantage. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage.

list.name: Duel
list.text: The Cost is reduced by [Tension], to a minimum of 1. Remove yourself and an adjacent enemy from the board; resolve the Duel (as described on page 38) when a participant starts their next Turn. Reward: The loser takes 2 Wounds if they're a player, or [Tension × 2] + [Tier × 5] damage if they're an NPC. The initiator Teleports both participants to spaces on the board's edge.

list.name: Block
list.text: As a Reaction to being Attacked, gain [Body] Armor for the duration of the Attack and get pushed one space away from the attacker.

list.name: Dodge
list.text: As a Reaction to being Attacked, gain [Talent / 2] or [Mind / 2] Evasion, move 1 or 2 spaces, and stop all forced movement from that Attack. You're still the target of that Attack if you move out of its range.

list.name: Clash
list.text: As a Reaction to being Attacked, start an Opposed Roll with the attacker, with both rolling 3 + [Tier]. If the player loses, they may take 5 damage to redo the roll, or take the Attack. If the player wins, they deal [Spirit] damage to the attacker and reduce the incoming Attack's damage by the same amount.

list.name: Punish
list.text: As a Reaction to a target leaving adjacency with you, you may Swiftly Skirmish that target at no Cost.

list.name: Charge
list.text: Roll Spirit with [Tension] Advantage. Reward: Gain [Hits] Focus (minimum 2).

list.name: Hide
list.text: If you are on the board's edge and didn't start this Turn already Disappeared, you Disappear.

list.name: Investigate
list.text: Mark an NPC in [Mind] range. The Narrator must tell you the effects or value of one of the following: their Health; their Armor and/or Evasion; their Speed; their Passive(s); their Actions; or their Ace(s).

list.name: Interact
list.text: Use an adjacent object or objective.

list.name: Improvise
list.text: Create a 10 Health Obstacle adjacent to you or apply any non-Banish Effect to a character adjacent to you. Before using this Action, you may remove an Obstacle adjacent to you to reduce its Cost to 1.

list.name: Assassin
list.description: Burst damage from stealth using Mark.
list.passive: Disappear after Deployment. When Attacking a Marked character, Disappear after the Attack if not already Disappeared when it began.

actions.name: Neutralize Target
actions.text: Target any character and Mark them. This NPC's Attacks do not remove Mark.

actions.name: Slice
actions.text: Roll 3 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. If Disappeared, this NPC may reappear adjacent to the target and gain 2 + [Tier] Advantage. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage; if the target has no adjacent characters, add [Tier] damage.

ace.name: Hidden Blades
ace.text: For the rest of the Scene, whenever this NPC Disappears, leave a Hidden Blade in the space it left. It is Difficult Terrain that deals [Tier] damage to a character entering it, then removes itself.

list.name: Bruiser
list.description: Attacks to Daze, then deals extra damage.
list.passive: If this NPC's Attack cannot push its target the full distance, the target is Dazed.

actions.name: Beatdown
actions.text: Choose an adjacent Dazed target. Deal 2 damage to them 1 + [Tier] times.

actions.name: Skulduggery
actions.text: Choose all other targets in a 2 × 2 Zone placed on this NPC. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and push each target [Tier × 2] spaces.

ace.name: Decimate
ace.text: Indicate a 3 × 3 Zone centered on a space 2 spaces away and become Steady. At the end of the next Turn, use Skulduggery against every opponent in that Zone with 2 + [Tier] Advantage.

list.name: Behemoth
list.description: Endgame checkmate that creates Obstacles.

actions.name: Leap
actions.text: Disappear if this NPC has not Attacked this Turn. When it reappears, Launch and push every character within 2 spaces by 2 spaces unless they Dodge as if this were an Attack.

actions.name: Tore From Earth
actions.text: Choose up to 2 targets within 6 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and place a 15 + [Tier × 5] Health, 0 Armor Obstacle adjacent to them.

ace.name: Meteor
ace.text: Teleport to the middle of the board and become Steady. At the start of the next Turn, Attack every character without an Obstacle between them and this NPC, instantly dealing 2 Wounds.

list.name: Captor
list.description: Disrupts fragile targets at long range.

actions.name: Watch And Wait
actions.text: Place unique Difficult Terrain in an unoccupied space within 4 spaces. When a character enters it, remove it and this NPC may use Catch And Release against them.

actions.name: Catch And Release
actions.text: Choose a target within 4 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage; Weaken and Snare the target if enemies have not Attacked them this Round.

ace.name: Sticky Bomb
ace.text: Indicate an opponent within 5 spaces. At the end of the next Turn, use Catch And Release against every character within 3 spaces of them. Hit characters are pulled adjacent to and Snared by the indicated character instead of this NPC.

list.name: Executioner
list.description: Debilitating anti-tank attacks at a slow pace.
list.passive: This NPC is unaffected by Effects that lower its Speed or prevent movement.

actions.name: Focus
actions.text: Strengthen and Reinforce this NPC.

actions.name: Cleave
actions.text: When this NPC Attacks without being Charged, it becomes Charged instead. While Charged, its Speed is 1 and it gains 1 + [Tier] Armor. Choose all targets in an adjacent 2-space Line. Roll 6 + [Tier × 2], then lose Charged. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension × 2] damage; Shred a target if enemies have not Attacked them this Round.

ace.name: Bifurcate
ace.text: Indicate an opponent, become Charged, and become Steady. At the end of the next Turn, move adjacent to that opponent or as close as possible through as few spaces as possible, then use Cleave against opponents moved through or adjacent to.

list.name: Javelin
list.description: Creates and uses Fodder to make attacks.
list.passive: When this NPC Attacks, it may destroy a Fodder Zone in or adjacent to its space to extend its Attack range to 5 spaces.

actions.name: Call
actions.text: Create 1 + [Tier] Fodder within 4 spaces. The amount created decreases by 1 each time this is used in the same Round.

actions.name: Crushing Impact
actions.text: Choose other targets in a 2 × 2 Zone placed on this NPC. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Launch if there is only one target.

ace.name: Shockwave
ace.text: Indicate a 5 × 5 Zone centered on this NPC and become Steady. At the end of the next Turn, use Crushing Impact against opposing targets in that Zone with [Tier] Advantage.

list.name: Pugilist
list.description: All-rounder with rotating Effects on Attack.
list.passive: Each time this NPC Attacks, apply the next step, resetting after step 4: 1 — push the target 3 spaces, then follow; 2 — Snare the target; 3 — Launch the target; 4 — if the target is Launched, gain double Advantage from Spiking them.

actions.name: Take Stance
actions.text: Set this NPC's Passive to any step, then Strengthen it.

actions.name: Flurry Of Strikes
actions.text: Roll 5 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage; Slow the target if enemies have not Attacked them this Round.

ace.name: Martial Perfection
ace.text: For the rest of combat, trigger this NPC's Passive twice on each Attack. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Ranger
list.description: Ultra-long-ranged attacker with high damage.
list.passive: After this NPC is Attacked, it may move 1 space.

actions.name: Nest
actions.text: Become Steady and gain 1 Aim. Aim is lost when this NPC moves on its Turn and adds 1 damage to all of its successful Attacks.

actions.name: Take The Shot
actions.text: Choose a character within 8 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Deal [Tier + 2] additional damage if the target is at least 4 spaces away and enemies have not Attacked them this Round. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage.

ace.name: Headshot
ace.text: Choose any target. The next time this NPC's Attack hits them, they receive an additional [Hits] damage.

list.name: Ronin
list.description: Fast and versatile attacker with on-Crit Effects.
list.passive: Start each Turn with 1 additional AP, but this NPC can target the same character only once each Turn.

actions.name: Sheath
actions.text: The next time this NPC moves, it must spend 3 AP, but may also use Dissect against every character it moves into or out of adjacency with.

actions.name: Dissect
actions.text: This Attack is Swift. Choose an adjacent target and roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage. If at least 2 Crits were rolled, Shred and Slow the target.

ace.name: Thunderclap And Flash
ace.text: Become Steady and indicate 4 Lines of any length connected end to end, with one connected to this NPC. At the end of the next Turn, move across every Line to the final end, ignoring characters and Terrain, then use Dissect against each opponent moved over or entered adjacency with. This Attack Crits on 5s.

list.name: Viper
list.description: Spreads Blight and deals burst damage if not stopped.
list.passive: After Attacking, move up to 3 spaces ignoring opponents. If this NPC passes through an opponent it has not Attacked this Turn, it may use Filet against them.

actions.name: Lick The Knife
actions.text: Deal damage to each Blighted player equal to the number of Blighted players + [Tier].

actions.name: Filet
actions.text: Choose an adjacent target, or do not activate the Passive to choose one within 5 spaces. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Blight the target. If already Blighted, Mark them.

ace.name: Knife In The Dark
ace.text: Disappear. At the end of the next Turn, use Filet to Teleport adjacent to and Attack every player without an adjacent ally, then reappear in any space.

list.name: Witch
list.description: Area-of-effect ranged attacker with slow movement.
list.passive: After Attacking, indicate a 3 × 3 Zone centered on the space Attacked. At the end of the next Turn, every player in that Zone takes [Tier] damage.

actions.name: Drawing Runes
actions.text: This Action costs 2 AP. Create a 3 × 3 Zone centered on this NPC, replacing any other such Zone. While this NPC is in it, every die it rolls counts as a Hit.

actions.name: Expelling Force
actions.text: Choose a target within 5 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and push the target 2 spaces away.

ace.name: EXPLOSION
ace.text: Indicate a 4 × 4 Zone anywhere on the board and become Steady. At the end of the next Turn, this NPC may use Expelling Force against all opponents in the Zone with 1 + [Tier] Advantage, then remove the Zone.

list.name: Bodyguards
list.description: Enhanced Fodder that can buff allies.
list.passive: When this NPC would Deploy, Deploy 4 + [Tier] unique Fodder Zones instead. It cannot be Knocked Out until all of its Fodder Zones, or all non-Fodder characters, are Knocked Out; when either happens, this NPC takes 1 damage.

actions.name: Brace
actions.text: If at least 3 Fodder Zones are in a Line, they all become impassable until the Line is broken.

actions.name: Behind Me
actions.text: Move every Fodder Zone up to 1 space. Choose up to 3 characters adjacent to a Fodder Zone. Reinforce allied targets. Against opponents, roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Daze targets enemies have not Attacked this Round.

ace.name: Reinforcements
ace.text: Create 3 + [Tier] Fodder Zones in spaces on the edge of the board. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Broodmother
list.description: Creates Fodder when hit and Taunts.
list.passive: When this NPC takes damage while there are 5 + [Tier × 2] or fewer Fodder Zones on the board, it may place a Fodder Zone within 2 spaces.

actions.name: Call
actions.text: Create 1 + [Tier] Fodder within 4 spaces. The amount created decreases by 1 each time this is used in the same Round.

actions.name: Swarming Chase
actions.text: Move this NPC and all adjacent allies 1 space. Roll 4 + [Tier] against opponents this NPC moves adjacent to. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage, plus 1 for each Fodder Zone adjacent to the Broodmother.

ace.name: Roar
ace.text: Taunt all opponents in a 5 × 5 Zone centered on this NPC. It immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Cocoon
list.description: Endgame threat that absorbs Attacks early.
list.passive: Start combat Scenes Docile. While Docile, this NPC cannot move or Attack and gains 1 Growth when it ends its Turn. On starting a Turn with at least 3 Growth, lose Docile and restore 10 + [Tier × 2] Health if any is missing.

actions.name: Menace
actions.text: Fear all opponents within 3 spaces. If this NPC is Docile, an ally may move or Attack.

actions.name: Rampage
actions.text: Move up to 3 spaces in a straight Line, ignoring every form of restriction. Roll 4 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and repeat this Attack, targeting only characters not Attacked this Turn.

ace.name: Quick Growth
ace.text: Gain 1 Growth. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Duelist
list.description: Forces single targets to Attack this NPC in duels.
list.passive: Characters who Attack or are Attacked by this NPC are Taunted by it.

actions.name: Goad
actions.text: Taunt a character. If already Taunted by this NPC, force them to spend 2 Focus or move 3 spaces directly toward it, becoming Dazed if they move adjacent.

actions.name: Flèche
actions.text: Choose a target within 2 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. If the target is Taunted, deal [Tier] additional damage. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and move 1 space.

ace.name: Disassemble
ace.text: Place a weak point in an unoccupied space adjacent to a character; it follows its host's movement. When this NPC Attacks the host while standing in the weak point, deal [Tension] additional damage, consume the weak point, and this Ace may be used again immediately.

list.name: Glutton
list.description: Eats Fodder to heal and spits them out.
list.passive: When this NPC Knocks Out a Fodder Zone, restore 3 + [Tier] Health and track how many times this healing triggers.

actions.name: Call
actions.text: Create 1 + [Tier] Fodder within 4 spaces. The amount created decreases by 1 each time this is used in the same Round.

actions.name: Slobber
actions.text: Choose up to 2 adjacent targets. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Slow targets enemies have not Attacked this Round.

ace.name: Regurgitate
ace.text: Place as many Fodder Zones as this NPC destroyed with its Passive in spaces of your choice. Characters under placed Zones are Launched.

list.name: Guardian
list.description: Protects allies from a specific direction.
list.passive: Spaces adjacent to this NPC count as Difficult Terrain for its opponents.

actions.name: Guardian Shield
actions.text: Slow this NPC and place an adjacent 2 × 3 shield until the start of its next Turn; the Zone moves with it. Opponents Attacking in this area treat their targets as having 1 + [Tier] additional Armor.

actions.name: Shove
actions.text: Roll 4 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage, push the target 2 spaces away, and Launch them.

ace.name: Imposing Presence
ace.text: For the rest of the Scene, characters adjacent to this NPC or within its shield are Taunted.

list.name: Mount
list.description: Attaches to fragile allies to protect and enhance them.
list.passive: When Deployed, or as an Action, this NPC may let a willing adjacent character Mount it, replacing any previous rider. Rider and Mount stay in the same space when either moves. Attacks targeting only an NPC rider target this NPC instead.

actions.name: Synergy
actions.text: Use the rider's Action, or any 1-Cost Utility Action if the rider is a player.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.text: Choose up to 2 adjacent targets. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage.

ace.name: CHARGE!
ace.text: Move up to this NPC's Speed in a straight Line. When the movement ends, its rider may use their Attack or Skirmish with [Tier] Advantage. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Oni
list.description: Switches between healing and tanking stances.
list.passive: Deploy Strengthened. When Attacked, lose all positive Effects. On losing Strengthened, become Reinforced; on losing Reinforced, become Strengthened.

actions.name: Stabilize
actions.text: Lose this NPC's Effects and Hasten it.

actions.name: Polaris
actions.text: If Strengthened, move up to 2 spaces in a straight Line and target all characters entered adjacency with. If Reinforced, affect all allies in a centered 3 × 3 Zone except this NPC. Roll 5 + [Tier]; if both Effects apply, choose one mode. Reward: if Strengthened, deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Launch; if Reinforced, restore [Hits] Health and Hasten.

ace.name: Vibrant Terror
ace.text: For the rest of the Scene, this NPC gains double the benefits from positive Effects. It immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Paladin
list.description: Can both Daze enemies and heal allies.
list.passive: When this NPC Attacks allies, it deals no damage and restores the same amount of Health instead.

actions.name: Gospel
actions.text: Reinforce Regenerating allies.

actions.name: Gift From God
actions.text: Choose up to 2 adjacent targets. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Daze an opposing target enemies have not Attacked this Round, or give an allied target Regenerating.

ace.name: Weal And Woe
ace.text: Use Gift From God against all characters within 2 spaces.

list.name: Revenant
list.description: Immortal NPC that drains Focus on Attack.
list.passive: This NPC grants no Tension when Knocked Out. If Knocked Out at the start of a Round, return it to the board at full Health in an unoccupied space of your choice.

actions.name: Lurk
actions.text: All opponents with at most 1 Focus are Feared by non-Revenant characters within 2 spaces.

actions.name: Tear From The Soul
actions.text: Choose a target within 3 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and make the target lose 1 + [Tier] Focus.

ace.name: Hollowed Eyes
ace.text: Indicate the player with the least Focus. At the end of the next Turn, use Tear From The Soul, Teleport adjacent to that player, and gain 6 + [Tier] Advantage minus the target's current Focus.

list.name: Spright
list.description: Dodge tank that benefits from movement.
list.passive: When this NPC ends movement, gain Evasion equal to the distance from its original position.

actions.name: Discombobulate
actions.text: Choose an adjacent target. If it has more Evasion than Armor, Slow it; if more Armor than Evasion, Shred it; if it has neither, Mark it.

actions.name: Incision
actions.text: Roll 5 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Teleport to the space adjacent to the target that is farthest from the NPC's current space.

ace.name: Thunderous Ascension
ace.text: Increase this NPC's Speed by [Tier × 2]. For the rest of the Scene, once per Turn, when it moves into every space adjacent to an opponent, Slow and Daze that opponent. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Bannerman
list.description: Enhances and moves allies close to this NPC.
list.passive: When this NPC moves, any ally in a centered 3 × 3 Zone may move adjacent to its new position.

actions.name: In Position
actions.text: Choose an ally within 6 spaces and a direction. Strengthen and Reinforce them, then move them 1 space in that direction, pushing obstructing characters. Repeat on adjacent allies, including this repeat, at most once per target.

actions.name: Swing
actions.text: Roll 4 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Weaken the target if enemies have not Attacked them this Round.

ace.name: Plant The Flag
ace.text: Place 15 + [Tier × 5] Health Terrain adjacent to this NPC. While it exists, use In Position at the start of each Round, and replace this NPC's Attack with another NPC's Attack from the board until the Terrain is destroyed.

list.name: Builder
list.description: Creates Terrain to disrupt enemies.
list.passive: This NPC can move through Obstacles.

actions.name: Landscape
actions.text: Choose up to 3 unoccupied spaces within 4 spaces and make them High or Low Terrain.

actions.name: Violent Construction
actions.text: Choose a target within 6 spaces. Deal 2 + [Tier] damage and place a 15 + [Tier × 5] Health Obstacle adjacent to them.

ace.name: Army Of Stone
ace.text: Turn every piece of Terrain on the board into an allied Fodder Zone. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Coordinator
list.description: Has allies make extra Attacks on its Turn.
list.passive: Allies within 4 spaces count as Strengthened during this NPC's Turn.

actions.name: Neutralize Them
actions.text: Choose and Mark a target within 4 spaces.

actions.name: Fanaticize
actions.text: Move up to 1 space and roll 5 + [Tier] against an adjacent target. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and have an ally move up to its Speed or use its primary Attack against a character not Attacked this Turn. A player ally may Cast or Skirmish.

ace.name: Coordinated Charge
ace.text: Every other enemy within 5 spaces may move up to its Speed or use Fanaticize against a character not Attacked this Turn.

list.name: Doppelgänger
list.description: Transforms into allies and duplicates itself.
list.passive: If this NPC did not start its Turn Imitating another NPC, it may Attack twice during that Turn.

actions.name: Imitate
actions.text: Imitate an allied NPC, replacing this NPC's non-Health statistics, Passive, Action, and Attack with the ally's. Imitation lasts until this NPC takes damage; it may then Teleport to a space within 6 spaces. It cannot Imitate the same NPC on consecutive Turns.

ace.name: Diplopia
ace.text: Create 2 copies of this NPC in unoccupied adjacent spaces with the same Tier and current Health. This NPC immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Healer
list.description: Chooses a favorite ally and heals them.
list.passive: At the start of this NPC's Turn, it may choose an ally as its Guardian. While adjacent to its Guardian, this NPC does not count as a target if the Guardian is closer to an Attack when targets are chosen.

actions.name: Heal
actions.text: Restore 2 + [Tier] Health to an ally within 3 spaces. Double this healing for this NPC's Guardian.

actions.name: Exsanguinate
actions.text: Choose a target within 5 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and Mark the target. Whenever any Marked opponent is Attacked, the attacker restores 5 + [Tier] Health.

ace.name: Savior
ace.text: Remove all Effects from this NPC's Guardian; the Guardian begins Regenerating.

list.name: Illusionist
list.description: Swaps the positions of characters freely.
list.passive: At the start of this NPC's Turn, it may swap the positions of any 2 NPCs. This counts as Teleporting for both.

actions.name: Spatial Rift
actions.text: Create 3 Walls with 10 + [Tier × 3] Health anywhere on the board.

actions.name: Distort Reality
actions.text: Choose any number of adjacent targets. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and put each target in Flux. When a character in Flux starts their Turn, this NPC may apply its Passive to them as if they were an NPC, removing Flux.

ace.name: Shattered Skies
ace.text: Immobilize this NPC. At the start of its next Turn, use Distort Reality against all opponents.

list.name: Matriarch
list.description: Creates safe spaces where allies are immune.
list.passive: At the start of each Round, designate a space. For the rest of the Round, non-Matriarch enemies in that space are not targets unless a Matriarch is trying to target them.

actions.name: Caress
actions.text: Choose any character and Teleport them to the designated space, or Teleport a character from the designated space elsewhere.

actions.name: Destroy The Interloper
actions.text: Choose a target in the designated space. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage, Banish the target, and move them up to 4 spaces.

ace.name: Mother Of The Void
ace.text: For the rest of the Scene, this NPC may designate 2 spaces with its Passive. It immediately takes another Turn.

list.name: Martyr
list.description: Takes damage to protect and heal allies.
list.passive: At the end of each Round, restore 5 + [Tier] Health to this NPC.

actions.name: Gorge On My Flesh
actions.text: Deal 1 + [Tier] damage to this NPC. Until the end of its next Turn, all allies within 4 spaces gain 2 + [Tier] Armor.

actions.name: Savor My Blood
actions.text: Choose a target within 5 spaces. Roll 5 + [Tier]. Reward: Deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage and restore Health to this NPC equal to half its missing Health.

ace.name: Sacrifice
ace.text: Knock Out this NPC and restore Health to all allies equal to twice each ally's Armor. Trigger this automatically if this NPC is Knocked Out while Tension is at least 4.

list.name: Baron
list.description: Bans specific Attacks and punishes their users.
list.passive: At the start of its Turn, name Skirmish, Cast, or Finisher, without repeating the previous choice. Once per Round when a player initiates the named Action, this NPC may Teleport to an empty adjacent space, become the target, and deal [Tier + 2] damage to that player.

actions.name: Prescript
actions.text: Choose up to 3 opponents. Each indicates a space; if they do not end their next Turn there, they receive a Wound.

actions.name: Suppress
